blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__account_daily_metrics
      description: Daily account metrics from events with page and feature aggregates left-joined to the event base.
      grain: One row per account_id per occurred_on present in staging.stg_pendo__event
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      business_logic: '- In each source (events, feature_event, page_event), derive occurred_on by truncating occurred_at to the day (date). - Aggregate events by occurred_on and account_id to create the base: distinct visitor count, total minutes, total events, and total event records. - Aggregate page events by occurred_on and account_id: distinct visitors with page activity and distinct pages viewed. - Aggregate feature events by occurred_on and account_id: distinct features clicked (a visitor distinct count is computed in the CTE but not used in the final output). - Left join page and feature aggregates to the event base on occurred_on and account_id. - When a joined aggregate is missing for a given account/date, set these outputs to 0: pages viewed, features clicked, page-viewing visitors, and feature-clicking visitors. - Note: feature-clicking visitors is populated from the page visitor aggregate (not from feature events) as implemented. - Output includes only account/date pairs that appear in the events base.'
      columns:
      - name: occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date obtained by truncating occurred_at to the day.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier used to group metrics by date.
      - name: count_active_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors from events for the account/date; NULL visitor_id values are excluded.
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of num_minutes from events for the account/date; NULL values are ignored; returns NULL if all are NULL.
      - name: sum_events
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of num_events from events for the account/date; NULL values are ignored; returns NULL if all are NULL.
      - name: count_event_records
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of event rows for the account/date.
      - name: count_pages_viewed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct pages viewed from page events for the account/date; NULL page_id excluded; set to 0 when no page metrics join.
      - name: count_features_clicked
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct features clicked from feature events for the account/date; NULL feature_id excluded; set to 0 when no feature metrics join.
      - name: count_page_viewing_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with page events for the account/date; NULL visitor_id excluded; set to 0 when no page metrics join.
      - name: count_feature_clicking_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors sourced from the page visitor aggregate for the account/date (not from feature events); set to 0 when no page metrics join.

- name: int_pendo__calendar_spine
      description: Daily calendar spine from the earliest application creation date through the date one week after query time, inclusive
      grain: One row per date_day in the generated inclusive range
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__application_history
      business_logic: '- Determine start_date as the earliest non-null created_at date in staging.stg_pendo__application_history; if none exist, start_date is NULL. - Determine end_date as the calendar date that is seven days after the query’s current date. - Build an inclusive daily sequence from start_date to end_date with a one-day step and output one row per day as date_day. - If start_date is NULL or occurs after end_date, the result is empty. - No explicit ordering is applied; consumers should not rely on row order. - Each date appears exactly once and is not NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date for each day in the inclusive range; unique, non-null, and row order is not guaranteed
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__conversion_funnel_analysis
      description: Daily account+app funnel metrics from Pendo events with 30-day rolling averages, trend, health rating, and optimization recommendations
      grain: One row per account_id, app_id, event_date
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      business_logic: 'Build daily account-level conversion funnel metrics and 30-day cohort summaries: - daily_events (union all) - Page views: from staging.stg_pendo__event as event_type=page_view; fields include visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date (day-level from occurred_at), entity_id=page_id, num_events, num_minutes. - Feature interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event as event_type=feature_click; entity_id=feature_id; carry num_events and num_minutes. - Deep page interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__page_event as event_type=page_interaction; per visitor/account/app/day/page aggregate counts of interactions (num_events) and summed minutes (num_minutes). - user_daily_funnel (per visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date) - Presence flags by type: has_page_view, has_feature_interaction, has_deep_interaction set to 1 if any such event exists that day, else 0. - Distinct entities: unique_pages_viewed, unique_features_used, unique_pages_interacted are distinct counts of entity_id by type. - Totals: total_page_events/total_feature_events/total_interaction_events and corresponding minutes are summed by type. - funnel_progression (per visitor/day) - Funnel stage precedence: Deep Engaged (all three flags=1) > Feature User (page and feature flags=1) > Page Visitor (page flag=1) > No Activity. - engagement_score = 0.1×total_page_events + 0.3×total_feature_events + 0.6×total_interaction_events + 0.05×(total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes). - session_quality: High Quality if total_minutes≥10 and unique_pages_viewed≥3 and unique_features_used≥2; else Medium Quality if total_minutes≥5 and unique_pages_viewed≥2; else Low Quality if total_page_minutes≥1; else Bounce. Here total_minutes = total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes. - account_funnel_metrics (per account_id, app_id, event_date) - Visitor counts: total_visitors = distinct visitor_id; visitors_with_page_views/features/deep = distinct visitors with the corresponding presence flag=1. - Conversion rates: page_to_feature = visitors_with_feature_use / visitors_with_page_views; feature_to_deep = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_feature_use; overall = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_page_views. If the denominator is 0, the rate is NULL. - Averages: avg_engagement_score and avg_pages_per_visitor are averaged over visitors with has_page_view=1; avg_features_per_user over visitors with has_feature_interaction=1; if no qualifying visitors, result is NULL. - Quality rates: high_quality_session_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''High Quality'' divided by total_visitors; bounce_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''Bounce'' divided by total_visitors; NULL if total_visitors=0. - conversion_cohort_analysis (per account_id, app_id; joined back to each daily row) - 30-day rolling averages relative to today (lower bound inclusive): average of daily page_to_feature, feature_to_deep, and overall conversion rates for dates on or after 30 days before today. - conversion_rate_trend = average overall conversion rate for dates on or after 7 days before today minus the average for dates from 30 to 7 days before today; both windows include the day 7 days ago. - funnel_health_rating by the 30-day average overall rate: Excellent (≥0.3), Good (≥0.2), Fair (≥0.1), else Poor. If the 30-day average is NULL, rating is Poor. - optimization_recommendation (first matching rule): if the 30-day average page→feature rate < 0.2 then “Focus on feature discovery and onboarding”; else if the 30-day average feature→deep rate < 0.3 then “Improve feature engagement and user guidance”; else if the 30-day average bounce rate > 0.6 then “Reduce bounce rate through better landing experience”; else “Maintain current optimization efforts”. - Final step: left join the cohort metrics to the daily account_funnel_metrics by account_id and app_id; set calculated_at to the query execution timestamp. Distinct counting ensures a visitor is counted once per day; averages ignore NULLs; no rounding is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier; grouping key for metrics and cohort join
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier within the account; grouping key for metrics and cohort join
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: event_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Day-level calendar date derived from occurred_at used for daily aggregation
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: total_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitor_id count per account_id, app_id, event_date across all event types
      - name: visitors_with_page_views
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with has_page_view=1 (at least one page_view event on the date)
      - name: visitors_with_feature_use
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with has_feature_interaction=1 (at least one feature_click event on the date)
      - name: visitors_with_deep_engagement
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with has_deep_interaction=1 (at least one page_interaction event on the date)
      - name: page_to_feature_conversion_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: visitors_with_feature_use divided by visitors_with_page_views; NULL if visitors_with_page_views=0
      - name: feature_to_deep_conversion_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: visitors_with_deep_engagement divided by visitors_with_feature_use; NULL if visitors_with_feature_use=0
      - name: overall_conversion_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: visitors_with_deep_engagement divided by visitors_with_page_views; NULL if visitors_with_page_views=0
      - name: avg_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average engagement_score over visitors with has_page_view=1; NULL if none
      - name: avg_pages_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average unique_pages_viewed over visitors with has_page_view=1; NULL if none
      - name: avg_features_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average unique_features_used over visitors with has_feature_interaction=1; NULL if none
      - name: high_quality_session_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Distinct visitors with session_quality='High Quality' divided by total_visitors; NULL if total_visitors=0
      - name: bounce_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Distinct visitors with session_quality='Bounce' divided by total_visitors; NULL if total_visitors=0
      - name: avg_30d_page_to_feature_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of daily page_to_feature_conversion_rate for dates on or after 30 days before today (inclusive); NULL if no data
      - name: avg_30d_feature_to_deep_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of daily feature_to_deep_conversion_rate for dates on or after 30 days before today (inclusive); NULL if no data
      - name: avg_30d_overall_conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of daily overall_conversion_rate for dates on or after 30 days before today (inclusive); NULL if no data
      - name: conversion_rate_trend
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Avg over dates on/after 7 days before today minus avg over dates from 30 to 7 days before today; both include the 7-days-ago date; NULL if either window lacks data
      - name: funnel_health_rating
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Rating by 30-day average overall rate: Excellent (≥0.3), Good (≥0.2), Fair (≥0.1), else Poor'
      - name: optimization_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Based on 30-day averages: feature discovery if page→feature<0.2; engagement if feature→deep<0.3; reduce bounce if bounce rate>0.6; else maintain'
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp of computation set to the query execution time

references.name: staging.stg_pendo__event
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build daily account-level conversion funnel metrics and 30-day cohort summaries: - daily_events (union all) - Page views: from staging.stg_pendo__event as event_type=page_view; fields include visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date (day-level from occurred_at), entity_id=page_id, num_events, num_minutes. - Feature interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event as event_type=feature_click; entity_id=feature_id; carry num_events and num_minutes. - Deep page interactions: from staging.stg_pendo__page_event as event_type=page_interaction; per visitor/account/app/day/page aggregate counts of interactions (num_events) and summed minutes (num_minutes). - user_daily_funnel (per visitor_id, account_id, app_id, event_date) - Presence flags by type: has_page_view, has_feature_interaction, has_deep_interaction set to 1 if any such event exists that day, else 0. - Distinct entities: unique_pages_viewed, unique_features_used, unique_pages_interacted are distinct counts of entity_id by type. - Totals: total_page_events/total_feature_events/total_interaction_events and corresponding minutes are summed by type. - funnel_progression (per visitor/day) - Funnel stage precedence: Deep Engaged (all three flags=1) > Feature User (page and feature flags=1) > Page Visitor (page flag=1) > No Activity. - engagement_score = 0.1×total_page_events + 0.3×total_feature_events + 0.6×total_interaction_events + 0.05×(total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes). - session_quality: High Quality if total_minutes≥10 and unique_pages_viewed≥3 and unique_features_used≥2; else Medium Quality if total_minutes≥5 and unique_pages_viewed≥2; else Low Quality if total_page_minutes≥1; else Bounce. Here total_minutes = total_page_minutes + total_feature_minutes + total_interaction_minutes. - account_funnel_metrics (per account_id, app_id, event_date) - Visitor counts: total_visitors = distinct visitor_id; visitors_with_page_views/features/deep = distinct visitors with the corresponding presence flag=1. - Conversion rates: page_to_feature = visitors_with_feature_use / visitors_with_page_views; feature_to_deep = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_feature_use; overall = visitors_with_deep_engagement / visitors_with_page_views. If the denominator is 0, the rate is NULL. - Averages: avg_engagement_score and avg_pages_per_visitor are averaged over visitors with has_page_view=1; avg_features_per_user over visitors with has_feature_interaction=1; if no qualifying visitors, result is NULL. - Quality rates: high_quality_session_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''High Quality'' divided by total_visitors; bounce_rate = distinct visitors with session_quality=''Bounce'' divided by total_visitors; NULL if total_visitors=0. - conversion_cohort_analysis (per account_id, app_id; joined back to each daily row) - 30-day rolling averages relative to today (lower bound inclusive): average of daily page_to_feature, feature_to_deep, and overall conversion rates for dates on or after 30 days before today. - conversion_rate_trend = average overall conversion rate for dates on or after 7 days before today minus the average for dates from 30 to 7 days before today; both windows include the day 7 days ago. - funnel_health_rating by the 30-day average overall rate: Excellent (≥0.3), Good (≥0.2), Fair (≥0.1), else Poor. If the 30-day average is NULL, rating is Poor. - optimization_recommendation (first matching rule): if the 30-day average page→feature rate < 0.2 then “Focus on feature discovery and onboarding”; else if the 30-day average feature→deep rate < 0.3 then “Improve feature engagement and user guidance”; else if the 30-day average bounce rate > 0.6 then “Reduce bounce rate through better landing experience”; else “Maintain current optimization efforts”. - Final step: left join the cohort metrics to the daily account_funnel_metrics by account_id and app_id; set calculated_at to the query execution timestamp. Distinct counting ensures a visitor is counted once per day; averages ignore NULLs; no rounding is applied.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__customer_rfm_analysis
      description: Visitor–account level RFM segmentation with strategies and account-level health metrics
      grain: One row per visitor_id + account_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor_account
      business_logic: '1) Aggregate events by visitor_id + account_id: - Active days: number of distinct calendar days with any event (based on occurred_at). - Active months: number of distinct calendar months with any event. - Total usage: sum of num_events and sum of num_minutes. - Average per record: mean of num_events (also compute mean of num_minutes for internal use). - Event records: number of event rows contributing to the group. - First/last activity dates: earliest and latest calendar day with any event. 2) For each visitor, count distinct associated accounts from the latest mapping; if missing, default the count to 1. 3) Keep only visitor–account pairs with at least one event. Compute: - recency_days: days from the last activity date to today. - customer_lifetime_days: days from the first activity date to today. 4) RFM scoring (1–5): - recency_score: 5 (≤7 days), 4 (≤30), 3 (≤90), 2 (≤180), else 1. - frequency_score from active days: 5 (≥50), 4 (≥25), 3 (≥10), 2 (≥5), else 1. - magnitude_score from total events and total minutes: 5 (≥1000 and ≥500), 4 (≥500 and ≥200), 3 (≥200 and ≥100), 2 (≥50 and ≥30), else 1. 5) Derive segment and value metrics: - rfm_composite_score: 0.3*recency + 0.4*frequency + 0.3*magnitude (stored with one decimal). - rfm_segment (first matching rule wins): • Champions: recency ≥4 and frequency ≥4 and magnitude ≥4 • Loyal Customers: frequency ≥4 and magnitude ≥4 • Potential Loyalists: recency ≥4 and frequency ≥3 and magnitude ≤3 • New Customers: recency ≥4 and frequency ≤2 and lifetime ≤60 days • Promising: magnitude ≥4 and frequency ≤3 • Customers Needing Attention: recency ≤2 and frequency ≥3 and magnitude ≥3 • About to Sleep: recency = 3 and frequency ≤3 and magnitude ≤3 • At Risk: recency ≤2 and frequency ≤2 and magnitude ≤3 • Cannot Be Retrieved: recency = 1 and frequency ≤2 • Hibernating: recency ≤2 and magnitude ≥4 • Others: otherwise - customer_value_tier from the product of the three scores: High Value (≥60), Medium Value (≥24), Low Value (≥8), else Minimal Value. - recommended_strategy: fixed text per rfm_segment. - predicted_clv_tier: based on rfm_segment; Very High CLV only for Champions or Loyal Customers with lifetime >180 days. - action_priority: fixed text per rfm_segment. 6) Account-level aggregation (per account across all visitor rows): - total_visitors. - Segment counts: Champions, Loyal Customers, Potential Loyalists, New Customers, and At Risk (At Risk + Cannot Be Retrieved). - Ratios (floating-point): • high_value_ratio = number of High Value visitors divided by total_visitors, • top_segment_ratio = number of Champions or Loyal Customers divided by total_visitors, • at_risk_ratio = number of At Risk or Cannot Be Retrieved divided by total_visitors. - Averages: mean composite score and means of the three scores. 7) Final output: - Left join account metrics to each visitor–account row. - calculated_at = the query execution timestamp. - Grain: one row per visitor_id + account_id.'
      columns:
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier paired with account_id; non-null key.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier paired with visitor_id; used to attach account metrics.
      - name: recency_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days since the most recent activity date to today.
      - name: count_active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar days with at least one event; duplicates within a day counted once.
      - name: count_active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar months with at least one event; duplicates within a month counted once.
      - name: total_events
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of num_events for the visitor–account; only pairs with at least one event are included.
      - name: total_minutes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of num_minutes for the visitor–account; non-null as only event-bearing pairs are included.
      - name: average_daily_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean of num_events across event records for the visitor–account; no rounding.
      - name: count_associated_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct accounts linked to the visitor from the latest mapping; defaults to 1 when missing.
      - name: customer_lifetime_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from the first activity date to today.
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Recency score (1–5): 5 if ≤7 days, 4 if ≤30, 3 if ≤90, 2 if ≤180, else 1.'
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Frequency score (1–5) from active days: 5 if ≥50, 4 if ≥25, 3 if ≥10, 2 if ≥5, else 1.'
      - name: magnitude_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Magnitude score (1–5) from total events and minutes: 5 if ≥1000 and ≥500; 4 if ≥500 and ≥200; 3 if ≥200 and ≥100; 2 if ≥50 and ≥30; else 1.'
      - name: rfm_composite_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Weighted sum 0.3*recency + 0.4*frequency + 0.3*magnitude stored with one decimal.
      - name: rfm_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Segment assigned by ordered rules using the three scores and lifetime; first matching rule applies.
      - name: customer_value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from the product of the three scores: High (≥60), Medium (≥24), Low (≥8), else Minimal.'
      - name: recommended_strategy
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic recommendation text mapped from rfm_segment; default is Standard engagement tactics.
      - name: predicted_clv_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: CLV tier from rfm_segment; Very High requires Champions or Loyal Customers with lifetime >180 days.
      - name: action_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Next-step priority mapped from rfm_segment: Retention & Advocacy, Growth & Upsell, Onboarding & Education, Re-engagement, Win-back or Deprioritize, Reactivation, or Monitor.'
      - name: account_total_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of visitor rows for the account; denominator for the ratios.
      - name: account_high_value_ratio
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of High Value visitors over total_visitors using floating-point division.
      - name: account_top_segment_ratio
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of Champions or Loyal Customers over total_visitors using floating-point division.
      - name: account_at_risk_ratio
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of At Risk or Cannot Be Retrieved visitors over total_visitors using floating-point division.
      - name: account_avg_rfm_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean rfm_composite_score across all visitors in the account.
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp applied uniformly to all output rows.

business_logic: '1) Aggregate events by visitor_id + account_id: - Active days: number of distinct calendar days with any event (based on occurred_at). - Active months: number of distinct calendar months with any event. - Total usage: sum of num_events and sum of num_minutes. - Average per record: mean of num_events (also compute mean of num_minutes for internal use). - Event records: number of event rows contributing to the group. - First/last activity dates: earliest and latest calendar day with any event. 2) For each visitor, count distinct associated accounts from the latest mapping; if missing, default the count to 1. 3) Keep only visitor–account pairs with at least one event. Compute: - recency_days: days from the last activity date to today. - customer_lifetime_days: days from the first activity date to today. 4) RFM scoring (1–5): - recency_score: 5 (≤7 days), 4 (≤30), 3 (≤90), 2 (≤180), else 1. - frequency_score from active days: 5 (≥50), 4 (≥25), 3 (≥10), 2 (≥5), else 1. - magnitude_score from total events and total minutes: 5 (≥1000 and ≥500), 4 (≥500 and ≥200), 3 (≥200 and ≥100), 2 (≥50 and ≥30), else 1. 5) Derive segment and value metrics: - rfm_composite_score: 0.3*recency + 0.4*frequency + 0.3*magnitude (stored with one decimal). - rfm_segment (first matching rule wins): • Champions: recency ≥4 and frequency ≥4 and magnitude ≥4 • Loyal Customers: frequency ≥4 and magnitude ≥4 • Potential Loyalists: recency ≥4 and frequency ≥3 and magnitude ≤3 • New Customers: recency ≥4 and frequency ≤2 and lifetime ≤60 days • Promising: magnitude ≥4 and frequency ≤3 • Customers Needing Attention: recency ≤2 and frequency ≥3 and magnitude ≥3 • About to Sleep: recency = 3 and frequency ≤3 and magnitude ≤3 • At Risk: recency ≤2 and frequency ≤2 and magnitude ≤3 • Cannot Be Retrieved: recency = 1 and frequency ≤2 • Hibernating: recency ≤2 and magnitude ≥4 • Others: otherwise - customer_value_tier from the product of the three scores: High Value (≥60), Medium Value (≥24), Low Value (≥8), else Minimal Value. - recommended_strategy: fixed text per rfm_segment. - predicted_clv_tier: based on rfm_segment; Very High CLV only for Champions or Loyal Customers with lifetime >180 days. - action_priority: fixed text per rfm_segment. 6) Account-level aggregation (per account across all visitor rows): - total_visitors. - Segment counts: Champions, Loyal Customers, Potential Loyalists, New Customers, and At Risk (At Risk + Cannot Be Retrieved). - Ratios (floating-point): • high_value_ratio = number of High Value visitors divided by total_visitors, • top_segment_ratio = number of Champions or Loyal Customers divided by total_visitors, • at_risk_ratio = number of At Risk or Cannot Be Retrieved divided by total_visitors. - Averages: mean composite score and means of the three scores. 7) Final output: - Left join account metrics to each visitor–account row. - calculated_at = the query execution timestamp. - Grain: one row per visitor_id + account_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__data_quality_checks
      description: Consolidated data quality report across Pendo staging tables (summary, per-table completeness, consistency issues, and business logic violations)
      grain: 'One row per report line: 1 summary row; per-table rows for completeness; per-check-type rows for consistency; per-violation-type rows for business logic'
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__account_history
      - staging.stg_pendo__visitor_history
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      business_logic: 'Build a four-section report by computing intermediate checks and then UNION ALLing section-specific rows (column meanings vary by section; see column rules below). No output ordering is enforced. All timestamps use current_timestamp at query time. 1) Data completeness checks: - account_history: total records; count of NULL account_id; count of NULL first_visit_at; count of NULL last_visit_at; other counts set to 0. - visitor_history: total records; count of NULL visitor_id; other counts set to 0; sixth position is count of NULL account_id. - event: total records; second–sixth positions respectively count NULL visitor_id, NULL account_id, NULL occurred_at, NULL app_id, and count of num_events that are NULL or negative. - Later UNIONs align values by position from the first select’s column order. 2) Data consistency checks: five issue types with counts and descriptions: - timestamp_consistency: events with occurred_at in the future. - account_visitor_relationship: visitor_history rows whose non-NULL account_id does not exist in account_history. - event_visitor_relationship: events whose visitor_id does not exist in visitor_history. - negative_metrics: events with negative num_minutes or num_events. - chronological_consistency: accounts where first_visit_at and last_visit_at are both present and first_visit_at is after last_visit_at. 3) Business logic violations: four rules with counts and descriptions: - impossible_session_duration: events with num_minutes > 480. - excessive_daily_events: per visitor and day, sum num_events; count groups with sum > 10000. - duplicate_primary_keys: difference between total events and distinct event_key. - inactive_paying_accounts: accounts with no events in the last 90 days. 4) Summary quality metrics: - completeness_score: compute the share of complete records by subtracting the ratio of (sum of NULL primary keys + sum of missing names + sum of missing first visits) to (three times the sum of total records) from 1, then multiply by 100; return NULL if the denominator is zero. - consistency_score: compute 1 minus the ratio of total consistency violations to the overall total records, then multiply by 100; return NULL if the denominator is zero. - business_logic_score: compute 1 minus the ratio of total business logic violations to the overall total records, then multiply by 100; return NULL if the denominator is zero. - These totals are evaluated over a Cartesian product of the completeness, consistency, and business-logic CTEs, so each component’s sum is multiplied by the row counts of the other two CTEs. - calculated_at uses the current time. 5) Final UNION ALL report rows: - Data Quality Summary: 1 row with the three percentage scores; overall_quality_score is their average; quality_grade is Excellent (>=95), Good (>=85), Fair (>=70), else Poor; calculated_at from the summary CTE. - Data Completeness Details: one row per table_name with column mapping by position: table_name (text), total_records, null_primary_keys, missing_names, missing_first_visit (as text), and calculated_at as current time. - Data Consistency Issues: one row per check_type with column mapping by position: check_type (text), total_violations, NULL, NULL, violation_description (text), and calculated_at as current time. - Business Logic Violations: one row per violation_type with column mapping by position: violation_type (text), violation_count, NULL, NULL, description (text), and calculated_at as current time. Notes: - Outlier detection and data freshness CTEs are computed but not included in the final UNION, so they do not appear in the output. - DuckDB coerces types across the UNION by position: columns 2 and 6 are VARCHAR; columns 3–5 are FLOAT; NULLs are preserved.'
      columns:
      - name: report_section
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Section label; one of 'Data Quality Summary', 'Data Completeness Details', 'Data Consistency Issues', 'Business Logic Violations'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: completeness_score
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Section-dependent text: summary shows the completeness percentage as text (no explicit rounding); completeness details show table_name; consistency issues show check_type; business logic violations show violation_type; summary can be NULL if the denominator is zero.'
      - name: consistency_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: 'Numeric metric by section: summary shows the consistency percentage; completeness details show total_records; consistency issues show total_violations; business logic violations show violation_count.'
      - name: business_logic_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: 'Numeric metric by section: summary shows the business logic percentage; completeness details show null_primary_keys; consistency issues and business logic violations are NULL.'
      - name: overall_quality_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: 'Numeric metric by section: summary is the average of the three percentage scores; completeness details show missing_names; consistency issues and business logic violations are NULL.'
      - name: quality_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Section-dependent text: summary grade (Excellent/Good/Fair/Poor using thresholds 95/85/70); completeness details show missing_first_visit as text; consistency issues show violation_description; business logic violations show description.'
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the row was computed; summary uses its CTE value; other sections use current query time.
        tests:
        - not_null

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__feature_daily_metrics
      description: Daily per-feature usage and engagement metrics derived from feature events
      grain: One row per feature_id per occurred_on
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      business_logic: '- Derive occurred_on as the calendar day from occurred_at for each event. - Identify first-time activity across all history: - For each (visitor_id, feature_id), determine the earliest occurred_on they clicked the feature. - For each (account_id, feature_id), determine the earliest occurred_on they clicked the feature. - Aggregate by (occurred_on, feature_id): - sum_clicks: sum of num_events; NULL values are ignored and the result is NULL if all inputs are NULL. - count_click_events: number of event rows. - count_visitors: distinct count of visitor_id; NULL visitor_id is excluded. - count_accounts: distinct count of account_id; NULL account_id is excluded. - count_first_time_visitors: distinct count of visitor_id where the day equals their first-ever day for the feature; NULL visitor_id is excluded. - count_first_time_accounts: distinct count of account_id where the day equals their first-ever day for the feature; NULL account_id is excluded. - sum_minutes: sum of num_minutes; NULL values are ignored and the result is NULL if all inputs are NULL. - For each occurred_on, compute day totals across all features: - total_feature_clicks: sum of sum_clicks (ignores NULLs). - total_feature_visitors: sum of count_visitors. - total_feature_accounts: sum of count_accounts. - Final metrics per (occurred_on, feature_id): - count_return_visitors = count_visitors - count_first_time_visitors. - count_return_accounts = count_accounts - count_first_time_accounts. - avg_daily_minutes_per_visitor: sum_minutes divided by count_visitors, rounded to 3 decimals; returns NULL if there are no visitors or sum_minutes is NULL. - avg_daily_clicks_per_visitor: sum_clicks divided by count_visitors, rounded to 3 decimals; returns NULL if there are no visitors or sum_clicks is NULL. - percent_of_daily_feature_clicks: 100 times sum_clicks divided by the day’s total_feature_clicks, rounded to 3 decimals; returns NULL if the day total is zero or NULL. - percent_of_daily_feature_visitors: 100 times count_visitors divided by the day’s total_feature_visitors, rounded to 3 decimals; returns NULL if the day total is zero. - percent_of_daily_feature_accounts: 100 times count_accounts divided by the day’s total_feature_accounts, rounded to 3 decimals; returns NULL if the day total is zero. - Conventions: distinct counts remove duplicates and exclude NULLs; sums ignore NULLs; divisions return NULL when the denominator is zero; rounding is to three decimal places.'
      columns:
      - name: occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of the event; daily aggregation key
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature identifier grouped with occurred_on
      - name: sum_clicks
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Sum of num_events for the feature and day; ignores NULLs and is NULL if all inputs are NULL
      - name: count_click_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of event rows for the feature/day
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors for the feature/day; NULL visitor_id excluded
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct accounts for the feature/day; NULL account_id excluded
      - name: count_first_time_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors whose day equals their first-ever day for this feature
      - name: count_first_time_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct accounts whose day equals their first-ever day for this feature
      - name: count_return_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Visitors minus first-time visitors for the feature/day
      - name: count_return_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Accounts minus first-time accounts for the feature/day
      - name: avg_daily_minutes_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: sum_minutes per visitor for the day, rounded to 3 decimals; NULL if no visitors or sum_minutes is NULL
      - name: avg_daily_clicks_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: sum_clicks per visitor for the day, rounded to 3 decimals; NULL if no visitors or sum_clicks is NULL
      - name: percent_of_daily_feature_clicks
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 100 * sum_clicks divided by the day’s total feature clicks, rounded to 3 decimals; NULL if the day total is zero or NULL
      - name: percent_of_daily_feature_visitors
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 100 * count_visitors divided by the day’s total feature visitors, rounded to 3 decimals; NULL if the day total is zero
      - name: percent_of_daily_feature_accounts
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 100 * count_accounts divided by the day’s total feature accounts, rounded to 3 decimals; NULL if the day total is zero

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__feature_info
      description: Feature metadata enriched with page, application, product area, and creator/updater details via left joins; no aggregation.
      grain: One row per base record in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_feature; duplicates can occur if a joined table has multiple matches for a key.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_feature
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_application
      - staging.stg_pendo__group
      - staging.stg_pendo__user
      business_logic: '- Start with all columns from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_feature (feature_id, app_id, created_at, created_by_user_id, is_dirty, group_id, is_core_event, last_updated_at, last_updated_by_user_id, feature_name, page_id, root_version_id, stable_version_id, valid_through). No filtering, aggregation, or sorting. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page where page_id matches; add page_name, page_created_at, and page_valid_through. - Left join staging.stg_pendo__group by comparing group_id values after converting both sides to text; add group_name as product_area_name. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__latest_application where app_id matches application_id; add display_name as app_display_name and platform as app_platform. - Left join staging.stg_pendo__user as creator where created_by_user_id matches user_id; build created_by_user_full_name by concatenating first_name, a single space, and last_name; if either part is NULL or no user is found, the full name is NULL; add created_by_user_username from username. - Left join staging.stg_pendo__user as updater where last_updated_by_user_id matches user_id; build last_updated_by_user_full_name the same way; add last_updated_by_user_username from username. - Nulls and determinism: if a join finds no match, joined columns are NULL. Name concatenation preserves original casing and spacing and yields NULL if any component is NULL. No de-duplication; if a joined table has multiple rows for a key, multiple output rows may result. No ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique feature identifier.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier from the feature record used to join to the application.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the feature was created; passthrough.
      - name: created_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the creating user; used to join to the user table.
      - name: is_dirty
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the feature has unsaved changes; passthrough.
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Product area group identifier from the feature; joined to group by comparing as text.
      - name: is_core_event
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating the feature is a core event; passthrough.
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the most recent update; passthrough.
      - name: last_updated_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Identifier of the most recent updating user; used to join to the user table.
      - name: feature_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature display name; passthrough.
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated page identifier from the feature; used to join to the page.
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier; passthrough.
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier; passthrough.
      - name: valid_through
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Feature record validity end timestamp; passthrough.
      - name: product_area_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product area name from the group table; NULL if no matching group_id.
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name from the page table; NULL if no matching page_id.
      - name: page_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Page creation timestamp from the page table; NULL if no match.
      - name: page_valid_through
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Page record validity end timestamp from the page table; NULL if no match.
      - name: app_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application display name from the application table; NULL if no matching app_id.
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application platform from the application table; NULL if no match.
      - name: created_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator full name formed as first_name + single space + last_name; NULL if either part is missing or no user match.
      - name: created_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator username from the user table; NULL if no match.
      - name: last_updated_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Updater full name formed as first_name + single space + last_name; NULL if either part is missing or no user match.
      - name: last_updated_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Updater username from the user table; NULL if no match.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__guide_alltime_metrics
      description: Lifetime guide event metrics aggregated per guide_id
      grain: One row per guide_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__guide_event
      business_logic: 'Input: staging.stg_pendo__guide_event using fields guide_id, visitor_id, account_id, occurred_at, type. For each guide_id present in the source: - count_visitors: number of distinct visitor_id; records with NULL visitor_id are excluded. - count_accounts: number of distinct account_id; records with NULL account_id are excluded. - count_events: total number of rows (all events), including rows with NULLs in any field. - first_event_at: earliest occurred_at; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL for the guide. - last_event_at: latest occurred_at; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL for the guide. - Event-type visitor counts (shown, dismissed, advanced, completed, snoozed): for each listed type, count distinct visitor_id where event type exactly matches that value (case-sensitive). NULL visitor_id are excluded. A visitor is counted once per type regardless of multiple events, and may be counted in multiple type-specific columns. Output includes only guide_id values that appear in the source.'
      columns:
      - name: guide_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide identifier and grouping key; exactly one output row per guide_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors per guide; NULL visitor_id excluded; multiple events per visitor counted once
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct accounts per guide; NULL account_id excluded; multiple events per account counted once
      - name: count_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of events for the guide; no de-duplication; rows with NULL fields are included
      - name: first_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest occurred_at for the guide; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL
      - name: last_event_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest occurred_at for the guide; NULL if all occurred_at are NULL
      - name: count_visitors_shown
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with at least one event where the type is shown; NULL visitor_id excluded; counted once per visitor
      - name: count_visitors_dismissed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with at least one event where the type is dismissed; NULL visitor_id excluded; counted once per visitor
      - name: count_visitors_advanced
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with at least one event where the type is advanced; NULL visitor_id excluded; counted once per visitor
      - name: count_visitors_completed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with at least one event where the type is completed; NULL visitor_id excluded; counted once per visitor
      - name: count_visitors_snoozed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors with at least one event where the type is snoozed; NULL visitor_id excluded; counted once per visitor

Distinct counts exclude null IDs. Percentages are 0–100 when present.'

        data_type: DATE

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__guide_info
      description: Latest guide attributes joined with application details, creator/updater user info, and the count of unique steps
      grain: One row per guide_id from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_guide
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_guide
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_guide_step
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_application
      - staging.stg_pendo__user
      business_logic: '- Begin with intermediate.int_pendo__latest_guide and output one row per guide_id with all guide fields unchanged. - From intermediate.int_pendo__latest_guide_step, for each guide_id compute the number of unique step_id values; NULL step_id values are ignored; if a guide has step rows but all step_id values are NULL, the count is 0; if no step rows exist for a guide, there is no aggregate row and the joined count_steps is NULL. - Left join the latest application by comparing guide.app_id converted to a string with application.application_id; include display_name (app_display_name) and platform (app_platform); if no match, these fields are NULL. - Left join the user table twice: once for the creator by comparing created_by_user_id and user_id as strings, and once for the updater by comparing last_updated_by_user_id and user_id as strings; if no match, user-derived fields are NULL. - Build created_by_user_full_name and last_updated_by_user_full_name by concatenating first_name and last_name with a single space; if either name is NULL, the full name is NULL; usernames are passed through when present. - No sorting, filtering, trimming, or case normalization is applied; timestamps and numeric fields are passed through.'
      columns:
      - name: guide_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique guide identifier; defines the table grain
      - name: guide_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide display name from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application ID from the latest guide; used to join application by comparing as strings; pass-through
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide state from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: device_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Target device type from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Guide creation timestamp from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: created_by_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Creator user ID from the latest guide; used to join user by comparing as strings; pass-through
      - name: is_multi_step
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the guide has multiple steps; pass-through from the latest guide
      - name: is_training
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicates whether the guide is marked as training; pass-through from the latest guide
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: last_updated_by_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Updater user ID from the latest guide; used to join user by comparing as strings; pass-through
      - name: launch_method
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide launch method from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: published_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Guide publication timestamp from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: recurrence
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Recurring guide flag; pass-through from the latest guide
      - name: recurrence_eligibility_window
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Eligibility window flag for recurring guides; pass-through from the latest guide
      - name: reset_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Guide reset timestamp from the latest guide; pass-through; NULL if absent
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier from the latest guide; pass-through
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier from the latest guide; pass-through
      - name: app_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application display name from the latest application join; NULL if no match
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application platform from the latest application join; NULL if no match
      - name: created_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator full name as first_name and last_name joined by a single space; NULL if either name is NULL or no matching user
      - name: created_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator username from the user join; NULL if no matching user
      - name: last_updated_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Updater full name as first_name and last_name joined by a single space; NULL if either name is NULL or no matching user
      - name: last_updated_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Updater username from the user join; NULL if no matching user
      - name: count_steps
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique non-null step_id values per guide; 0 if only NULL step_id values are present; NULL if no step rows exist

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Begin with intermediate.int_pendo__latest_guide and output one row per guide_id with all guide fields unchanged. - From intermediate.int_pendo__latest_guide_step, for each guide_id compute the number of unique step_id values; NULL step_id values are ignored; if a guide has step rows but all step_id values are NULL, the count is 0; if no step rows exist for a guide, there is no aggregate row and the joined count_steps is NULL. - Left join the latest application by comparing guide.app_id converted to a string with application.application_id; include display_name (app_display_name) and platform (app_platform); if no match, these fields are NULL. - Left join the user table twice: once for the creator by comparing created_by_user_id and user_id as strings, and once for the updater by comparing last_updated_by_user_id and user_id as strings; if no match, user-derived fields are NULL. - Build created_by_user_full_name and last_updated_by_user_full_name by concatenating first_name and last_name with a single space; if either name is NULL, the full name is NULL; usernames are passed through when present. - No sorting, filtering, trimming, or case normalization is applied; timestamps and numeric fields are passed through.'

      description: Latest guide step per guide_id and step_id selected by most recent guide_last_updated_at.
      grain: One row per guide_id and step_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__guide_step_history
      business_logic: '- Read all records from staging.stg_pendo__guide_step_history. - For each (guide_id, step_id), order records by guide_last_updated_at from most recent to oldest. In DuckDB, NULLs sort first for descending order, so a NULL timestamp can be chosen as most recent. - Assign a rank starting at 1 based on this order within each (guide_id, step_id). - Keep only the record with rank 1 (the latest) for each (guide_id, step_id). - If multiple records have the same timestamp within a group, the selected record is arbitrary because no tie-breaker is specified. - Output columns: guide_id, step_id, guide_last_updated_at, latest_guide_step_index (always 1 for retained rows).'
      columns:

        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Step identifier; combined with guide_id to define the grouping for selecting the latest record.
      - name: guide_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide identifier; combined with step_id to define the grouping for selecting the latest record.
      - name: guide_last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp used to order records within each (guide_id, step_id) from most recent to oldest; NULLs are treated as most recent.
      - name: latest_guide_step_index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Rank within (guide_id, step_id) based on recency; ties are arbitrary; equal to 1 for all rows in this table.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__latest_nps_rating
      description: Latest NPS rating per visitor from Pendo NPS polls
      grain: One row per visitor_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__poll
      - staging.stg_pendo__poll_event
      business_logic: '- Keep only polls whose attribute_type equals ''npsrating'' using a case-insensitive comparison; rows with NULL attribute_type are excluded. - Inner join poll events to these NPS polls on poll_id to retain only NPS poll events. - For each visitor_id, sort events by occurred_at descending (most recent first). If multiple events have the same occurred_at, the chosen row among ties is engine-defined. NULL timestamps are ordered according to the engine’s default for descending order. - For each visitor_id, select the first event in this order and output: - visitor_id - account_id from the selected event - nps_rating as the poll_response converted to integer (NULL if poll_response is NULL) - The result contains at most one row per visitor_id that has at least one NPS poll event.'
      columns:
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier; one row per visitor with at least one NPS poll event; NULL visitors yield at most one row.
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account from the selected latest NPS event for the visitor; may be NULL; ties on occurred_at are resolved by engine-defined ordering.
      - name: nps_rating
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: NPS rating from the selected event converted to integer; NULL when poll_response is NULL.

- name: int_pendo__latest_page_rule
      description: Latest page rule per (page_id, rule) based on the most recent page_last_updated_at.

      source_models:

      - name: rule

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__page_daily_metrics
      description: 'Daily page-level usage metrics: totals, distinct counts, first-time vs returning, averages per visitor, and per-day shares across pages.'
      grain: One row per occurred_on per page_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      business_logic: '- Derive occurred_on by truncating occurred_at to the calendar day. - For each visitor_id and page_id, determine the earliest occurred_on as visitor_first_event_on; for each account_id and page_id, determine account_first_event_on. - Aggregate per occurred_on and page_id: - sum_pageviews is the total of num_events; null values do not contribute. - count_pageview_events is the number of records. - count_visitors is the distinct count of visitor_id; null visitor_id is excluded. - count_accounts is the distinct count of account_id; null account_id is excluded. - count_first_time_visitors is the distinct count of visitor_id where occurred_on matches the visitor''s earliest day on that page; null visitor_id is excluded. - count_first_time_accounts is the distinct count of account_id where occurred_on matches the account''s earliest day on that page; null account_id is excluded. - sum_minutes is the total of num_minutes; null values do not contribute. - For each occurred_on, compute day totals across all pages by summing page-level aggregates: - total_pageviews sums sum_pageviews across pages. - total_page_visitors sums count_visitors across pages (visitors may be counted on multiple pages the same day). - total_page_accounts sums count_accounts across pages (accounts may be counted on multiple pages the same day). - Final per occurred_on and page_id: - count_return_visitors = count_visitors minus count_first_time_visitors; count_return_accounts = count_accounts minus count_first_time_accounts. - avg_daily_minutes_per_visitor = sum_minutes divided by count_visitors, rounded to three decimals; null when count_visitors is zero. - avg_daily_pageviews_per_visitor = sum_pageviews divided by count_visitors, rounded to three decimals; null when count_visitors is zero. - percent_of_daily_pageviews = 100 × sum_pageviews divided by total_pageviews, rounded to three decimals; null when total_pageviews is zero. - percent_of_daily_page_visitors = 100 × count_visitors divided by total_page_visitors (summed across pages), rounded to three decimals; null when total_page_visitors is zero. - percent_of_daily_page_accounts = 100 × count_accounts divided by total_page_accounts (summed across pages), rounded to three decimals; null when total_page_accounts is zero.'

        data_type: DATE

      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR

      - name: sum_pageviews
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total num_events for the page on the day; null num_events are ignored.
      - name: count_pageview_events
        data_type: BIGINT

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct visitors whose visit occurs on their first day viewing this page; null visitor_id is excluded.
      - name: count_first_time_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct accounts whose visit occurs on their first day viewing this page; null account_id is excluded.

        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Visitors minus first-time visitors for the page on the day; expected non-negative.
      - name: count_return_accounts

      - name: avg_daily_pageviews_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average pageviews per visitor for the page on the day, rounded to three decimals; null when there are zero visitors.

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Page's share of the day's total pageviews across all pages, rounded to three decimals; null when the daily total is zero.
      - name: percent_of_daily_page_visitors

      - name: percent_of_daily_page_accounts

        description: Page's share of the day's summed account counts across pages, rounded to three decimals; null when the daily total is zero.

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__page_info
      description: Enhanced page metadata enriched with application, product area, aggregated rules, and recent active feature count
      grain: One row per page_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - staging.stg_pendo__user
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_application
      - staging.stg_pendo__group
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page_rule
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_feature
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page as the base (one row per page_id). - Aggregate page rules from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page_rule by page_id: - Concatenate rule values using ", " as the delimiter. - Exclude NULL rule values; preserve duplicates; no explicit ordering. - If a page has no non-NULL rules, the aggregated value is NULL. - Derive the active feature count from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_feature: - Include features whose valid_through is within 30 days before the current time or any time after. - Group by page_id and count rows with non-NULL feature_id. - Left join to pages and set missing counts to 0; the current time is evaluated when the query runs. - Left join application data on app_id = application_id; bring display_name and platform. - Left join product area on group_id matched by comparing IDs as strings; bring group_name as product_area_name. - Left join creator and updater users on their respective user_id: - Full names are built by joining first name, a space, and last name; if either name is missing or there is no match, the full name is NULL. - Bring creator and updater usernames. - Output the base fields plus joined and derived fields; one row per page_id.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique page identifier; exactly one output row per page_id
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page name passed through from latest_page
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier from latest_page; used to join latest_application
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Page creation timestamp from latest_page; passed through; may be NULL
      - name: created_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator user_id from latest_page; used to join stg_pendo__user for creator fields
      - name: is_dirty
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from latest_page indicating unsaved changes; passed through
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Group/product area identifier from latest_page; matched to stg_pendo__group by comparing IDs as strings
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from latest_page; passed through; may be NULL
      - name: last_updated_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Updater user_id from latest_page; used to join stg_pendo__user for updater fields
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier from latest_page; passed through
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier from latest_page; passed through
      - name: valid_through
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Validity end timestamp from latest_page; passed through
      - name: rules
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Comma-separated rule values per page from latest_page_rule using delimiter ', '; excludes NULLs, preserves duplicates, no defined order; NULL when none
      - name: product_area_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Group name from stg_pendo__group matched by group_id using string comparison; NULL if no match
      - name: app_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application display_name from latest_application via app_id; NULL if no match
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application platform from latest_application via app_id; NULL if no match
      - name: created_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator full name built as first name, a space, and last name; NULL if either name is missing or no user match
      - name: created_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator username from stg_pendo__user; NULL if no match
      - name: last_updated_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Updater full name built as first name, a space, and last name; NULL if either name is missing or no user match
      - name: last_updated_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Updater username from stg_pendo__user; NULL if no match
      - name: count_active_features
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of non-NULL feature_id per page where valid_through is within 30 days before now or in the future; returns 0 when no features; evaluated at query time

business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page as the base (one row per page_id). - Aggregate page rules from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page_rule by page_id: - Concatenate rule values using ", " as the delimiter. - Exclude NULL rule values; preserve duplicates; no explicit ordering. - If a page has no non-NULL rules, the aggregated value is NULL. - Derive the active feature count from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_feature: - Include features whose valid_through is within 30 days before the current time or any time after. - Group by page_id and count rows with non-NULL feature_id. - Left join to pages and set missing counts to 0; the current time is evaluated when the query runs. - Left join application data on app_id = application_id; bring display_name and platform. - Left join product area on group_id matched by comparing IDs as strings; bring group_name as product_area_name. - Left join creator and updater users on their respective user_id: - Full names are built by joining first name, a space, and last name; if either name is missing or there is no match, the full name is NULL. - Bring creator and updater usernames. - Output the base fields plus joined and derived fields; one row per page_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__product_health_metrics
      description: Overall product health metrics combining NPS, feature adoption, retention, and engagement with derived grades and risk
      grain: One row per account_id and fam.app_id; if no feature_adoption_metrics row exists, rows appear per account_id with app_id NULL (there can be multiple such rows per account when only engagement data exists)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_nps_rating
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      business_logic: '- NPS metrics (by account_id from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_nps_rating): - total_nps_responses is the total row count per account; avg_nps_score is the mean of nps_rating (ignoring NULLs). - promoter_rate is the share of rows with nps_rating ≥ 9 using total_nps_responses as the denominator (NULL ratings not counted in the numerator but included in the denominator). - detractor_rate is the share of rows with nps_rating ≤ 6 using total_nps_responses as the denominator (NULL ratings not counted in the numerator but included in the denominator). - net_promoter_score = promoter_rate − detractor_rate. - Feature adoption metrics (by app_id, account_id from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event): - total_features_available is distinct features; features_used is distinct features with any usage (>0 events); features_heavily_used is distinct features with ≥10 events. - total_users is distinct visitors; active_feature_users is distinct visitors with any feature usage (>0 events). - feature_adoption_rate = features_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - feature_depth_adoption_rate = features_heavily_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - user_feature_adoption_rate = active_feature_users ÷ total_users (returns NULL when total_users = 0). - avg_features_per_user = features_used ÷ active_feature_users (returns NULL when active_feature_users = 0). - Distinct counts exclude NULL IDs; duplicates are removed. - Visitor aggregated metrics (by account_id, visitor_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - count_active_days is the distinct count of active calendar days; sum_events and sum_minutes are totals across events; last_event_on is the most recent active calendar day. - User retention metrics (by account_id from visitor_aggregated_metrics): - total_users is distinct visitors. - retention_7d/30d/90d are the shares of visitors whose last_event_on is within 7/30/90 days of current_date; denominators are total_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - highly_active_user_rate is the share of visitors with count_active_days ≥ 20 (denominator is total_users; no explicit zero-division guard). - avg_lifetime_events is the mean of sum_events per visitor; avg_active_days_per_user is the mean of count_active_days per visitor. - Engagement quality metrics (by account_id, app_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - avg_session_duration is the mean minutes per session; avg_events_per_session is the mean events per session (NULLs ignored in averages). - unique_users is distinct visitors; total_sessions is the session row count; sessions_per_user = total_sessions ÷ unique_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - deep_engagement_session_rate is the share of sessions with ≥10 minutes or ≥20 events (denominator is total_sessions). - power_user_rate assumes 20% are high-frequency users: equals 0.2 when unique_users > 0, else NULL. - Product health scores: - Join feature_adoption_metrics (fam) and user_retention_metrics (urm) with a full outer join on account_id. - Join engagement_quality_metrics (eqm) with a full outer join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm and require app_id to match fam.app_id; rows with only engagement data are kept but will have app_id NULL in the output. - Join nps_metrics (nm) with a left join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm; NPS does not attach for engagement-only rows. - account_id is coalesced from fam, then urm, then eqm; app_id comes only from fam. - overall_health_score is a 0–100 score capped at 100, computed as the sum of: - up to 25 points from NPS by scaling net_promoter_score from [-1,1] to [0,25] (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from feature_adoption_rate (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from retention_30d (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from engagement: deep_engagement_session_rate (up to 12.5) and power_user_rate (up to 12.5) (missing treated as 0). - Health categorization: - health_grade: Excellent (score ≥ 80), Good (≥ 60), Fair (≥ 40), Poor (≥ 20), else Critical. - primary_improvement_area (first match wins): if net_promoter_score is missing treat as −1; if feature_adoption_rate, retention_30d, or deep_engagement_session_rate are missing treat as 0; then check in order: NPS < 0, adoption < 0.3, 30‑day retention < 0.5, deep engagement < 0.2; otherwise maintain/optimize. - risk_level: High Risk if score < 30; Medium Risk if (score < 50 and 30‑day retention < 0.4, treating missing retention as 0) or net_promoter_score < −0.2 (treating missing NPS as 0); else Low. - calculated_at is set to the current timestamp at execution.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier coalesced from feature adoption, retention, or engagement sources; always populated
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier taken from feature adoption metrics; NULL when no feature adoption row exists (possible multiple NULL-app rows per account from engagement-only data)
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp set via current_timestamp (database time zone)
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: '0–100 score from weighted components: NPS scaled to 0–25, feature adoption 0–25, 30‑day retention 0–25, and engagement (deep sessions and power users) 0–25; missing inputs contribute 0 and the sum is capped at 100'
      - name: health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Grade by score: Excellent (≥80), Good (≥60), Fair (≥40), Poor (≥20), else Critical'
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High if score<30; Medium if (score<50 and 30‑day retention<0.4 treating missing as 0) or NPS<−0.2 treating missing as 0; else Low
      - name: feature_adoption_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Proportion of distinct features with any usage (>0 events) over all distinct features; returns NULL when no features
      - name: feature_depth_adoption_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Proportion of distinct features with ≥10 events over all distinct features; returns NULL when no features
      - name: user_feature_adoption_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Proportion of visitors who used any feature over all distinct visitors; returns NULL when no visitors
      - name: retention_7d
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of visitors whose last active day is within 7 days of current_date; denominator is distinct visitors and no zero-division guard is applied
      - name: retention_30d
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of visitors whose last active day is within 30 days of current_date; denominator is distinct visitors and no zero-division guard is applied
      - name: retention_90d
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of visitors whose last active day is within 90 days of current_date; denominator is distinct visitors and no zero-division guard is applied
      - name: avg_session_duration
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average minutes per session from staging.stg_pendo__event grouped by account_id and app_id; NULL values are ignored
      - name: avg_events_per_session
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average events per session from staging.stg_pendo__event grouped by account_id and app_id; NULL values are ignored
      - name: sessions_per_user
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Total sessions divided by unique users (distinct visitors); no zero-division guard if unique_users=0
      - name: avg_active_days_per_user
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean distinct active days per visitor by account; NULLs are ignored in the average
      - name: avg_lifetime_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean total events per visitor by account; NULLs are ignored in the average
      - name: avg_features_per_user
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Features_used divided by active_feature_users; returns NULL when there are no active feature users
      - name: features_used
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of feature_id with any usage (>0 events); NULL feature_id excluded
      - name: total_features_available
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of available feature_id; NULL feature_id excluded
      - name: power_user_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Assumed constant 0.2 when at least one unique user exists, else NULL
      - name: highly_active_user_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of visitors with count_active_days ≥ 20; denominator is distinct visitors; no zero-division guard
      - name: deep_engagement_session_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of sessions with ≥10 minutes or ≥20 events; denominator is total sessions
      - name: avg_nps_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average NPS rating per account; NULL ratings are ignored
      - name: net_promoter_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Promoter share minus detractor share using the total row count per account as the denominator
      - name: promoter_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of rows with nps_rating ≥ 9 using all rows as the denominator; NULL ratings excluded from the numerator but included in the denominator
      - name: detractor_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Share of rows with nps_rating ≤ 6 using all rows as the denominator; NULL ratings excluded from the numerator but included in the denominator
      - name: total_nps_responses
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total rows per account in intermediate.int_pendo__latest_nps_rating, including rows with NULL ratings
      - name: primary_improvement_area
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Priority guidance (first match wins): treat missing NPS as −1 and other metrics as 0, then check NPS<0, feature adoption<0.3, 30‑day retention<0.5, deep engagement<0.2; otherwise maintain/optimize'
