references.line_text: business_logic: '- NPS metrics (by account_id from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_nps_rating): - total_nps_responses is the total row count per account; avg_nps_score is the mean of nps_rating (ignoring NULLs). - promoter_rate is the share of rows with nps_rating ≥ 9 using total_nps_responses as the denominator (NULL ratings not counted in the numerator but included in the denominator). - detractor_rate is the share of rows with nps_rating ≤ 6 using total_nps_responses as the denominator (NULL ratings not counted in the numerator but included in the denominator). - net_promoter_score = promoter_rate − detractor_rate. - Feature adoption metrics (by app_id, account_id from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event): - total_features_available is distinct features; features_used is distinct features with any usage (>0 events); features_heavily_used is distinct features with ≥10 events. - total_users is distinct visitors; active_feature_users is distinct visitors with any feature usage (>0 events). - feature_adoption_rate = features_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - feature_depth_adoption_rate = features_heavily_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - user_feature_adoption_rate = active_feature_users ÷ total_users (returns NULL when total_users = 0). - avg_features_per_user = features_used ÷ active_feature_users (returns NULL when active_feature_users = 0). - Distinct counts exclude NULL IDs; duplicates are removed. - Visitor aggregated metrics (by account_id, visitor_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - count_active_days is the distinct count of active calendar days; sum_events and sum_minutes are totals across events; last_event_on is the most recent active calendar day. - User retention metrics (by account_id from visitor_aggregated_metrics): - total_users is distinct visitors. - retention_7d/30d/90d are the shares of visitors whose last_event_on is within 7/30/90 days of current_date; denominators are total_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - highly_active_user_rate is the share of visitors with count_active_days ≥ 20 (denominator is total_users; no explicit zero-division guard). - avg_lifetime_events is the mean of sum_events per visitor; avg_active_days_per_user is the mean of count_active_days per visitor. - Engagement quality metrics (by account_id, app_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - avg_session_duration is the mean minutes per session; avg_events_per_session is the mean events per session (NULLs ignored in averages). - unique_users is distinct visitors; total_sessions is the session row count; sessions_per_user = total_sessions ÷ unique_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - deep_engagement_session_rate is the share of sessions with ≥10 minutes or ≥20 events (denominator is total_sessions). - power_user_rate assumes 20% are high-frequency users: equals 0.2 when unique_users > 0, else NULL. - Product health scores: - Join feature_adoption_metrics (fam) and user_retention_metrics (urm) with a full outer join on account_id. - Join engagement_quality_metrics (eqm) with a full outer join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm and require app_id to match fam.app_id; rows with only engagement data are kept but will have app_id NULL in the output. - Join nps_metrics (nm) with a left join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm; NPS does not attach for engagement-only rows. - account_id is coalesced from fam, then urm, then eqm; app_id comes only from fam. - overall_health_score is a 0–100 score capped at 100, computed as the sum of: - up to 25 points from NPS by scaling net_promoter_score from [-1,1] to [0,25] (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from feature_adoption_rate (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from retention_30d (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from engagement: deep_engagement_session_rate (up to 12.5) and power_user_rate (up to 12.5) (missing treated as 0). - Health categorization: - health_grade: Excellent (score ≥ 80), Good (≥ 60), Fair (≥ 40), Poor (≥ 20), else Critical. - primary_improvement_area (first match wins): if net_promoter_score is missing treat as −1; if feature_adoption_rate, retention_30d, or deep_engagement_session_rate are missing treat as 0; then check in order: NPS < 0, adoption < 0.3, 30‑day retention < 0.5, deep engagement < 0.2; otherwise maintain/optimize. - risk_level: High Risk if score < 30; Medium Risk if (score < 50 and 30‑day retention < 0.4, treating missing retention as 0) or net_promoter_score < −0.2 (treating missing NPS as 0); else Low. - calculated_at is set to the current timestamp at execution.'

features_used is distinct features with any usage (>0 events); features_heavily_used is distinct features with ≥10 events. - total_users is distinct visitors; active_feature_users is distinct visitors with any feature usage (>0 events). - feature_adoption_rate = features_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - feature_depth_adoption_rate = features_heavily_used ÷ total_features_available (returns NULL when total_features_available = 0). - user_feature_adoption_rate = active_feature_users ÷ total_users (returns NULL when total_users = 0). - avg_features_per_user = features_used ÷ active_feature_users (returns NULL when active_feature_users = 0). - Distinct counts exclude NULL IDs; duplicates are removed. - Visitor aggregated metrics (by account_id, visitor_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - count_active_days is the distinct count of active calendar days; sum_events and sum_minutes are totals across events; last_event_on is the most recent active calendar day. - User retention metrics (by account_id from visitor_aggregated_metrics): - total_users is distinct visitors. - retention_7d/30d/90d are the shares of visitors whose last_event_on is within 7/30/90 days of current_date; denominators are total_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - highly_active_user_rate is the share of visitors with count_active_days ≥ 20 (denominator is total_users; no explicit zero-division guard). - avg_lifetime_events is the mean of sum_events per visitor; avg_active_days_per_user is the mean of count_active_days per visitor. - Engagement quality metrics (by account_id, app_id from staging.stg_pendo__event): - avg_session_duration is the mean minutes per session; avg_events_per_session is the mean events per session (NULLs ignored in averages). - unique_users is distinct visitors; total_sessions is the session row count; sessions_per_user = total_sessions ÷ unique_users (no explicit zero-division guard). - deep_engagement_session_rate is the share of sessions with ≥10 minutes or ≥20 events (denominator is total_sessions). - power_user_rate assumes 20% are high-frequency users: equals 0.2 when unique_users > 0, else NULL. - Product health scores: - Join feature_adoption_metrics (fam) and user_retention_metrics (urm) with a full outer join on account_id. - Join engagement_quality_metrics (eqm) with a full outer join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm and require app_id to match fam.app_id; rows with only engagement data are kept but will have app_id NULL in the output. - Join nps_metrics (nm) with a left join on the coalesced account_id from fam/urm; NPS does not attach for engagement-only rows. - account_id is coalesced from fam, then urm, then eqm; app_id comes only from fam. - overall_health_score is a 0–100 score capped at 100, computed as the sum of: - up to 25 points from NPS by scaling net_promoter_score from [-1,1] to [0,25] (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from feature_adoption_rate (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from retention_30d (missing treated as 0), - up to 25 points from engagement: deep_engagement_session_rate (up to 12.5) and power_user_rate (up to 12.5) (missing treated as 0). - Health categorization: - health_grade: Excellent (score ≥ 80), Good (≥ 60), Fair (≥ 40), Poor (≥ 20), else Critical. - primary_improvement_area (first match wins): if net_promoter_score is missing treat as −1; if feature_adoption_rate, retention_30d, or deep_engagement_session_rate are missing treat as 0; then check in order: NPS < 0, adoption < 0.3, 30‑day retention < 0.5, deep engagement < 0.2; otherwise maintain/optimize. - risk_level: High Risk if score < 30; Medium Risk if (score < 50 and 30‑day retention < 0.4, treating missing retention as 0) or net_promoter_score < −0.2 (treating missing NPS as 0); else Low. - calculated_at is set to the current timestamp at execution.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__user_lifecycle_segments
      description: User lifecycle segmentation derived from Pendo event activity, recency, and intensity
      grain: One row per visitor_id-account scope; account_id is used during aggregation but is not selected, so a visitor may appear multiple times across accounts
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      business_logic: '- Aggregate events by (visitor_id, account_id): - count_active_days: number of distinct calendar days with at least one event. - count_active_months: number of distinct calendar months with at least one event. - sum_events: total of num_events; NULLs are ignored and NULL is returned only if all values are NULL. - sum_minutes: total of num_minutes; NULLs are ignored and NULL is returned only if all values are NULL. - average_daily_events: arithmetic mean of num_events across grouped rows with values. - average_daily_minutes: arithmetic mean of num_minutes across grouped rows with values. - first_event_on: earliest event date (calendar day). - last_event_on: most recent event date (calendar day). - Keep only groups where first_event_on is present. - Derive: - user_age_days: whole days between first_event_on and today. - days_since_last_active: whole days between last_event_on and today. - activity_density: if user_age_days > 0, count_active_days divided by user_age_days; otherwise 0. - usage_intensity: label by average_daily_events thresholds: High (≥50), Medium (≥20), Low (≥5), Minimal (<5). - Classify lifecycle_stage in this order (first match wins): 1) New User: user_age_days ≤ 30 and count_active_days ≤ 7. 2) Growing User: user_age_days between 30 and 90, activity_density > 0.2, and days_since_last_active ≤ 30. 3) Mature User: user_age_days > 90, activity_density > 0.1, days_since_last_active ≤ 60, and usage_intensity is Medium or High. 4) Power User: activity_density > 0.3, usage_intensity is High, and days_since_last_active ≤ 14. 5) At Risk: user_age_days > 30, days_since_last_active between 30 and 90, and count_active_days ≥ 3. 6) Churned: days_since_last_active > 90. 7) Otherwise: Dormant. - Compute user_value_score and cap at 100: - activity_density × 30 - plus intensity points: High=25, Medium=15, Low=8, Minimal=2 - plus recency points: ≤7 days=25, ≤30 days=15, ≤90 days=5, else 0 - plus min(20, count_active_months × 2). - Determine engagement_trend (first match wins): - If days_since_last_active ≤ 30 and user_age_days > 60: Increasing if activity_density > 0.5; Stable if > 0.2; otherwise Declining. - Else if days_since_last_active ≤ 30: New/Recent. - Else: Inactive. - Determine churn_risk_level (first match wins): - If lifecycle_stage is Churned: Already Churned. - Else if lifecycle_stage is At Risk: High Risk. - Else Medium Risk if (days_since_last_active > 30 and usage_intensity is Minimal or Low) or (activity_density < 0.1 and user_age_days > 90); otherwise Low Risk. - Flags: - is_valuable_user: true for Power User or Mature User; else false. - needs_attention: true for At Risk or Churned; else false. - is_new_user: true for New User; else false. - calculated_at is set to the query execution timestamp.'
      columns:
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier; metrics are aggregated per account, so a visitor may appear in multiple rows across accounts
      - name: first_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest event date for the visitor within the account; ensured non-null by filtering
      - name: last_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Most recent event date for the visitor within the account
      - name: user_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from first_event_on to current_date; non-negative
      - name: days_since_last_active
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days from last_event_on to current_date; non-negative
      - name: count_active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar days with at least one event
      - name: count_active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct calendar months with at least one event
      - name: sum_events
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of num_events across grouped records; ignores NULLs; NULL only if all inputs are NULL
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of num_minutes across grouped records; ignores NULLs; NULL only if all inputs are NULL
      - name: average_daily_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean of num_events across grouped records with values; no rounding
      - name: average_daily_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Mean of num_minutes across grouped records with values; no rounding
      - name: activity_density
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: If user_age_days > 0, count_active_days divided by user_age_days; otherwise 0; no rounding
      - name: usage_intensity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Label based on average_daily_events: High (≥50), Medium (≥20), Low (≥5), else Minimal'
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle label from the ordered rules in business_logic; first match wins
      - name: user_value_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Composite score capped at 100 from activity density, intensity points, recency points, and active months; no rounding
      - name: engagement_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Trend based on recency and activity density: Increasing/Stable/Declining when recently active and age > 60, else New/Recent if recently active, else Inactive'
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk label: Already Churned for Churned stage; High Risk for At Risk stage; otherwise Medium Risk per recency/intensity or low density with age > 90; else Low Risk'
      - name: is_valuable_user
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if lifecycle_stage is Power User or Mature User; otherwise false
      - name: needs_attention
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if lifecycle_stage is At Risk or Churned; otherwise false
      - name: is_new_user
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if lifecycle_stage is New User; otherwise false
      - name: calculated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Timestamp when the query ran; time zone comes from the session

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_pendo__visitor_daily_metrics
      description: Daily visitor metrics from events with unique page and feature counts; rows only for visitor/day pairs present in events
      grain: One row per visitor_id per occurred_on present in staging.stg_pendo__event
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      business_logic: '- In each source table, derive occurred_on by truncating occurred_at to the calendar day (DATE). - From events, group by occurred_on and visitor_id; compute: - sum_minutes as the total of num_minutes (NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all values are NULL), - sum_events as the total of num_events (NULLs ignored; result is NULL if all values are NULL), - count_event_records as the number of event rows in the group. - From feature_event, group by occurred_on and visitor_id; compute count_features_clicked as the number of unique feature_id values (NULL feature_id excluded). - From page_event, group by occurred_on and visitor_id; compute count_pages_viewed as the number of unique page_id values (NULL page_id excluded). - Left join the feature and page aggregates to the event aggregates on occurred_on and visitor_id; replace missing feature/page counts with 0. - Emit one row per (occurred_on, visitor_id) present in events; days with only feature or page activity are excluded.'
      columns:
      - name: occurred_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date truncated from event occurred_at; may be NULL; grouping key
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier from events; NULL values are grouped and retained
      - name: sum_events
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of num_events across event rows for the visitor/day; ignores NULLs; NULL if all values are NULL
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total of num_minutes across event rows for the visitor/day; ignores NULLs; NULL if all values are NULL
      - name: count_event_records
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of event rows for the visitor/day; always at least 1 for emitted rows
      - name: count_pages_viewed
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique pages viewed for the visitor/day from page events; NULL page_id excluded; defaults to 0 when absent
      - name: count_features_clicked
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique features clicked for the visitor/day from feature events; NULL feature_id excluded; defaults to 0 when absent

blocks.original_text:
- name: account
      description: Account dimension enriched with visitor counts, NPS aggregates, and all-time usage metrics joined to the latest account profile (one row per account_id)
      grain: One row per account_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor_account
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_nps_rating
      - intermediate.int_pendo__account_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account as the base (one record per account_id); all base columns are passed through unchanged. - From intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor_account, group by account_id and count unique, non-null visitor_id values to get count_associated_visitors. - From intermediate.int_pendo__latest_nps_rating, group by account_id to compute NPS metrics: minimum rating, maximum rating, and average rating; null ratings are ignored, and if an account has no ratings these fields remain null. - From intermediate.int_pendo__account_daily_metrics, group by account_id and aggregate across all available rows: - count_active_visitors, count_page_viewing_visitors, count_feature_clicking_visitors, sum_minutes, sum_events, count_event_records are summed over time. - count_active_days is the number of unique occurred_on dates (null dates are excluded). - count_active_months is the number of unique calendar months derived from occurred_on (null dates are excluded). - average_daily_minutes is total minutes divided by the number of active days; if there are no active days, this average is 0. - average_daily_events is total events divided by the number of active days; if there are no active days, this average is 0. - first_event_on is the earliest occurred_on date; last_event_on is the latest occurred_on date. - Left join the visitor, NPS, and daily aggregates to the base on account_id. - Default the following metrics to 0 when missing: count_associated_visitors, count_active_visitors, count_page_viewing_visitors, count_feature_clicking_visitors, count_active_days, count_active_months, sum_minutes, sum_events, count_event_records, average_daily_minutes, average_daily_events. NPS metrics and event dates are not defaulted. - The result contains exactly one row per account_id.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary key from latest_account and join key; one output row per account_id.
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through last update timestamp string from latest_account; may be null.
      - name: account_id_hash
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Pass-through numeric hash of account_id from latest_account; may be null.
      - name: first_visit_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through first visit timestamp string from latest_account; may be null.
      - name: last_visit_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pass-through last visit timestamp string from latest_account; may be null.
      - name: latest_account_index
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Pass-through ordering/index field from latest_account; may be null.
      - name: count_associated_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique non-null visitors linked to the account; left joined and defaulted to 0 when none.
      - name: min_nps_rating
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Minimum NPS rating for the account; null ratings ignored; remains null if no ratings exist.
      - name: max_nps_rating
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Maximum NPS rating for the account; null ratings ignored; remains null if no ratings exist.
      - name: avg_nps_rating
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average NPS rating for the account; null ratings ignored; unrounded; remains null if no ratings exist.
      - name: count_active_visitors
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of daily active visitor counts across all time for the account; defaulted to 0 when missing.
      - name: count_page_viewing_visitors
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of daily page-viewing visitor counts across all time for the account; defaulted to 0 when missing.
      - name: count_feature_clicking_visitors
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sum of daily feature-clicking visitor counts across all time for the account; defaulted to 0 when missing.
      - name: count_active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique occurred_on dates with activity for the account; defaulted to 0 when none.
      - name: count_active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of unique calendar months with activity based on occurred_on; defaulted to 0 when none.
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total minutes of activity summed across all daily records for the account; defaulted to 0 when missing.
      - name: sum_events
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total events summed across all daily records for the account; defaulted to 0 when missing.
      - name: count_event_records
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total event records summed across all daily records for the account; defaulted to 0 when missing.
      - name: average_daily_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total minutes divided by the number of active days; returns 0 when no active days; unrounded.
      - name: average_daily_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total events divided by the number of active days; returns 0 when no active days; unrounded.
      - name: first_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Earliest occurred_on date for the account; null if no events.
      - name: last_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Latest occurred_on date for the account; null if no events.

- name: account_daily_metrics
      description: Daily account-level metrics aligned to a calendar spine from each account's first event through the current date.
      grain: One row per account_id per date_day; rows may duplicate if the source has multiple records for the same (account_id, occurred_on).

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer_lifecycle_insights
      description: Customer lifecycle insights combining visitor activity, lifecycle segmentation, RFM, product health, and derived journey classifications and scores
      grain: One row per visitor_id (from marts.pendo__visitor)
      source_models:
      - marts.pendo__visitor
      - intermediate.int_pendo__user_lifecycle_segments
      - intermediate.int_pendo__customer_rfm_analysis
      - intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics
      business_logic: 'Build a comprehensive customer record per visitor_id by joining base visitor activity with lifecycle, RFM, and product health, then derive journey labels, values, and recommendations: 1) Base rowset and joins - Start from marts.pendo__visitor (vb), one row per visitor_id; carry: visitor_id, account_id, first_event_on, last_event_on, count_active_days, count_active_months, sum_events, sum_minutes, average_daily_events, average_daily_minutes, count_associated_accounts. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__user_lifecycle_segments (lc) on visitor_id. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__customer_rfm_analysis (rfm) on visitor_id. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics (ph) on account_id. - Null policy: Left joins may yield missing lifecycle/RFM/health attributes; unless explicitly defaulted in rules below, missing values do not match conditions and fall to the default outcome. 2) Customer segmentation label (customer_segment_label) evaluated in order: - Power User + Champions → "Star Customer" - (Mature User or Power User) + High Value → "Key Account" - New User + New Customers → "Fresh Prospect" - Growing User + Potential Loyalists → "Rising Star" - churn_risk_level in (High Risk, Medium Risk) + At Risk → "Save Immediately" - lifecycle_stage = At Risk + action_priority = Re-engagement → "Rescue Mission" - lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Lost Customer" - Else → "Standard Customer" 3) Comprehensive customer value (comprehensive_customer_value, 0–100): - Compute a weighted sum: 40% of user_value_score (defaults to 0 if missing), 30% of (rfm_composite_score scaled to 0–100 by multiplying by 20; defaults to 0 if missing), and 30% of overall_health_score (defaults to 50 if missing). Cap the result at 100. No rounding beyond native numeric evaluation. 4) Recommended next action (recommended_next_action) evaluated in order: - Power User + Champions → "Leverage as advocate; Offer exclusive features; Request testimonials" - is_new_user = true + New Customers → "Intensive onboarding; Feature education; Success manager assignment" - needs_attention = true + action_priority = Re-engagement → "Personalized outreach; Usage analysis; Feature recommendations" - churn_risk_level = High Risk → "Immediate intervention; Executive outreach; Value demonstration" - lifecycle_stage = Growing User → "Feature adoption campaign; Usage optimization; Upgrade path guidance" - rfm_segment = Loyal Customers → "Upsell opportunities; Loyalty rewards; Advanced feature training" - Else → "Standard nurturing; Regular check-ins; Content engagement" 5) Customer journey stage (customer_journey_stage): - Define days since first event as the number of days from the first_event_on date to today. - If days since first event ≤ 30 → "Onboarding" - Else if lifecycle_stage in (Growing User, Mature User) and customer_value_tier in (High Value, Medium Value) → "Growth" - Else if lifecycle_stage in (Power User, Mature User) and rfm_segment in (Champions, Loyal Customers) → "Maturity" - Else if churn_risk_level in (High Risk, Medium Risk) or lifecycle_stage = At Risk → "Retention" - Else if lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Win-back" - Else → "Maintenance" 6) Predicted LTV tier (predicted_ltv_tier) evaluated in order: - lifecycle_stage in (Power User, Mature User) + customer_value_tier = High Value + overall_health_score ≥ 70 (treat missing health as 60 for this rule) → "Very High LTV" - (user_value_score ≥ 70 or rfm_composite_score ≥ 4) + churn_risk_level = Low Risk → "High LTV" - lifecycle_stage in (Growing User, New User) + predicted_clv_tier in (High CLV, Medium CLV) → "Moderate LTV" - churn_risk_level = High Risk or lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Low LTV" - Else → "Standard LTV" 7) Engagement velocity and trends (from comprehensive view): - engagement_velocity: ratio of count_active_days to days since first event; if either value is not positive, set to 0. - usage_trend: define a baseline average as sum_events divided by count_active_days when count_active_days > 0; if average_daily_events exceeds the baseline by more than 20% → "Accelerating"; if within ±20% → "Stable"; otherwise → "Declining". When count_active_days = 0, the baseline is undefined and the outcome is "Declining". - account_influence_level: count_associated_accounts > 3 → "Multi-Account Influencer"; > 1 → "Cross-Account User"; else → "Single Account User". - calculated_at: timestamp when the metrics are computed. 8) Final importance and investment expectation: - customer_importance_level (in order): - customer_segment_label in (Star Customer, Key Account) + predicted_ltv_tier = Very High LTV → "Critical" - comprehensive_customer_value ≥ 80 + customer_journey_stage in (Growth, Maturity) → "High" - comprehensive_customer_value ≥ 60 or customer_segment_label in (Rising Star, Fresh Prospect) → "Medium" - needs_attention = true or customer_journey_stage = Retention → "At Risk" - Else → "Standard" - investment_expectation: - Star Customer → "High ROI - Advocacy & Expansion" - Key Account → "High ROI - Retention & Upsell" - Rising Star → "Medium ROI - Growth Investment" - Fresh Prospect → "Medium ROI - Onboarding Investment" - Save Immediately → "Low ROI - Retention Cost" - Lost Customer → "Negative ROI - Win-back Cost" - Else → "Standard ROI - Maintenance" 9) Output all selected and derived columns; no additional filtering; grain remains one row per visitor_id.'
      columns:
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique visitor identifier and grouping key; exactly one output row per visitor_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account identifier from the visitor base used to join product health metrics
      - name: first_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the visitor's first recorded event used to compute days since first event
      - name: last_event_on
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date of the visitor's most recent recorded event as carried from the visitor base
      - name: count_active_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct active days for the visitor as carried from the visitor base
      - name: count_active_months
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of distinct active months for the visitor as carried from the visitor base
      - name: sum_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total count of events for the visitor; used to form the baseline average as sum_events divided by count_active_days
      - name: sum_minutes
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total minutes of activity for the visitor as carried from the visitor base
      - name: average_daily_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average events per calendar day from the visitor base compared against the baseline for usage_trend
      - name: average_daily_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average minutes per calendar day from the visitor base without further transformation
      - name: count_associated_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of accounts linked to the visitor; drives account_influence_level thresholds (>3, >1, else)
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from user_lifecycle_segments (left-joined by visitor_id; may be NULL)
      - name: user_value_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Lifecycle-derived user value score contributing 40% to comprehensive_customer_value
      - name: engagement_trend
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle-derived engagement trend label carried from user_lifecycle_segments
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle-derived churn risk level used in segmentation, journey stage, and LTV rules
      - name: is_valuable_user
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from lifecycle indicating valuable user status; may be NULL if lifecycle data is missing
      - name: needs_attention
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from lifecycle indicating attention needed; influences importance level
      - name: is_new_user
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag from lifecycle indicating a new user; used in next-action logic
      - name: activity_density
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Lifecycle-derived activity density metric carried through without modification
      - name: usage_intensity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle-derived usage intensity classification carried through without modification
      - name: rfm_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: RFM segment from customer_rfm_analysis (left-joined by visitor_id) used across segmentation and actions
      - name: customer_value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: RFM-derived customer value tier used in journey stage and LTV rules
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: RFM recency score carried from customer_rfm_analysis without transformation
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: RFM frequency score carried from customer_rfm_analysis without transformation
      - name: magnitude_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: RFM magnitude score carried from customer_rfm_analysis without transformation
      - name: rfm_composite_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: RFM composite score scaled by 20 and weighted 30% in comprehensive_customer_value
      - name: recommended_strategy
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: RFM-recommended strategy carried from customer_rfm_analysis without modification
      - name: predicted_clv_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: RFM-predicted CLV tier used to derive predicted_ltv_tier for specific lifecycle stages
      - name: action_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: RFM action priority value referenced in segmentation and next-action rules
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Account-level product health score that defaults to 50 in the composite value when missing
      - name: health_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account-level health grade label carried from product health metrics
      - name: primary_improvement_area
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account-level primary improvement area carried from product health metrics
      - name: product_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Account-level risk level from product health metrics renamed as product_risk_level
      - name: net_promoter_score
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Account-level NPS value carried from product health metrics without transformation
      - name: feature_adoption_rate
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: Account-level feature adoption rate carried from product health metrics
      - name: account_retention_30d
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: 30-day account retention rate carried from product health metrics
      - name: customer_segment_label
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic customer segment label from ordered rules combining lifecycle and RFM attributes
      - name: comprehensive_customer_value
        data_type: FLOAT
        description: 'Weighted composite score on a 0–100 scale: 0.4*user_value_score + 0.3*(rfm_composite_score*20) + 0.3*overall_health_score, capped at 100'
      - name: recommended_next_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic next-action recommendation from ordered rules over lifecycle and RFM signals
      - name: customer_journey_stage

references.name: marts.pendo__visitor
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build a comprehensive customer record per visitor_id by joining base visitor activity with lifecycle, RFM, and product health, then derive journey labels, values, and recommendations: 1) Base rowset and joins - Start from marts.pendo__visitor (vb), one row per visitor_id; carry: visitor_id, account_id, first_event_on, last_event_on, count_active_days, count_active_months, sum_events, sum_minutes, average_daily_events, average_daily_minutes, count_associated_accounts. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__user_lifecycle_segments (lc) on visitor_id. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__customer_rfm_analysis (rfm) on visitor_id. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics (ph) on account_id. - Null policy: Left joins may yield missing lifecycle/RFM/health attributes; unless explicitly defaulted in rules below, missing values do not match conditions and fall to the default outcome. 2) Customer segmentation label (customer_segment_label) evaluated in order: - Power User + Champions → "Star Customer" - (Mature User or Power User) + High Value → "Key Account" - New User + New Customers → "Fresh Prospect" - Growing User + Potential Loyalists → "Rising Star" - churn_risk_level in (High Risk, Medium Risk) + At Risk → "Save Immediately" - lifecycle_stage = At Risk + action_priority = Re-engagement → "Rescue Mission" - lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Lost Customer" - Else → "Standard Customer" 3) Comprehensive customer value (comprehensive_customer_value, 0–100): - Compute a weighted sum: 40% of user_value_score (defaults to 0 if missing), 30% of (rfm_composite_score scaled to 0–100 by multiplying by 20; defaults to 0 if missing), and 30% of overall_health_score (defaults to 50 if missing). Cap the result at 100. No rounding beyond native numeric evaluation. 4) Recommended next action (recommended_next_action) evaluated in order: - Power User + Champions → "Leverage as advocate; Offer exclusive features; Request testimonials" - is_new_user = true + New Customers → "Intensive onboarding; Feature education; Success manager assignment" - needs_attention = true + action_priority = Re-engagement → "Personalized outreach; Usage analysis; Feature recommendations" - churn_risk_level = High Risk → "Immediate intervention; Executive outreach; Value demonstration" - lifecycle_stage = Growing User → "Feature adoption campaign; Usage optimization; Upgrade path guidance" - rfm_segment = Loyal Customers → "Upsell opportunities; Loyalty rewards; Advanced feature training" - Else → "Standard nurturing; Regular check-ins; Content engagement" 5) Customer journey stage (customer_journey_stage): - Define days since first event as the number of days from the first_event_on date to today. - If days since first event ≤ 30 → "Onboarding" - Else if lifecycle_stage in (Growing User, Mature User) and customer_value_tier in (High Value, Medium Value) → "Growth" - Else if lifecycle_stage in (Power User, Mature User) and rfm_segment in (Champions, Loyal Customers) → "Maturity" - Else if churn_risk_level in (High Risk, Medium Risk) or lifecycle_stage = At Risk → "Retention" - Else if lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Win-back" - Else → "Maintenance" 6) Predicted LTV tier (predicted_ltv_tier) evaluated in order: - lifecycle_stage in (Power User, Mature User) + customer_value_tier = High Value + overall_health_score ≥ 70 (treat missing health as 60 for this rule) → "Very High LTV" - (user_value_score ≥ 70 or rfm_composite_score ≥ 4) + churn_risk_level = Low Risk → "High LTV" - lifecycle_stage in (Growing User, New User) + predicted_clv_tier in (High CLV, Medium CLV) → "Moderate LTV" - churn_risk_level = High Risk or lifecycle_stage = Churned → "Low LTV" - Else → "Standard LTV" 7) Engagement velocity and trends (from comprehensive view): - engagement_velocity: ratio of count_active_days to days since first event; if either value is not positive, set to 0. - usage_trend: define a baseline average as sum_events divided by count_active_days when count_active_days > 0; if average_daily_events exceeds the baseline by more than 20% → "Accelerating"; if within ±20% → "Stable"; otherwise → "Declining". When count_active_days = 0, the baseline is undefined and the outcome is "Declining". - account_influence_level: count_associated_accounts > 3 → "Multi-Account Influencer"; > 1 → "Cross-Account User"; else → "Single Account User". - calculated_at: timestamp when the metrics are computed. 8) Final importance and investment expectation: - customer_importance_level (in order): - customer_segment_label in (Star Customer, Key Account) + predicted_ltv_tier = Very High LTV → "Critical" - comprehensive_customer_value ≥ 80 + customer_journey_stage in (Growth, Maturity) → "High" - comprehensive_customer_value ≥ 60 or customer_segment_label in (Rising Star, Fresh Prospect) → "Medium" - needs_attention = true or customer_journey_stage = Retention → "At Risk" - Else → "Standard" - investment_expectation: - Star Customer → "High ROI - Advocacy & Expansion" - Key Account → "High ROI - Retention & Upsell" - Rising Star → "Medium ROI - Growth Investment" - Fresh Prospect → "Medium ROI - Onboarding Investment" - Save Immediately → "Low ROI - Retention Cost" - Lost Customer → "Negative ROI - Win-back Cost" - Else → "Standard ROI - Maintenance" 9) Output all selected and derived columns; no additional filtering; grain remains one row per visitor_id.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: executive_dashboard_metrics
      description: Executive KPI snapshot derived from account history, product health metrics, and 30-day event trends (single-row platform summary)
      grain: Exactly one row (global platform snapshot at execution time)
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__account_history
      - intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics
      - staging.stg_pendo__event
      business_logic: '- Build account_performance_summary: - Source: staging.stg_pendo__account_history left join intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics on account_id. - One row per account with: account_id, account_name set equal to account_id, agent_is_paying=true, agent_planlevel=''Standard'', first_visit=first_visit_at, last_visit=last_visit_at. - Set per-account defaults: critical_customers=0, high_value_customers=0, customers_at_risk=0, onboarding_customers=0, total_active_users=0, avg_customer_value_score=50.0, high_ltv_customers=0. - For each account, derive product metrics as the maximum values across joined product_health rows: product_health_score (overall_health_score), account_nps (net_promoter_score), feature_adoption_rate, and customer_retention_30d. - Derive revenue_health_indicators from account_performance_summary: - revenue_health_status: - If agent_is_paying and avg_customer_value_score ≥ 80 → Excellent; if agent_is_paying and ≥ 60 → Good; if agent_is_paying and < 60 → At Risk. - If not paying and high_ltv_customers > 0 → Conversion Opportunity; otherwise Standard. - account_risk_level (in order): if customers_at_risk / total_active_users > 0.3 → High Risk; else if > 0.15 → Medium Risk; else if product_health_score < 50 → Medium Risk; else if account_nps < 0 → High Risk; otherwise Low Risk. When total_active_users=0, the ratio is treated as NULL and later rules apply. - growth_potential (in order): if high_ltv_customers > (critical_customers + high_value_customers) and feature_adoption_rate > 0.4 → High Growth Potential; else if onboarding_customers > 0 and avg_customer_value_score > 60 → Moderate Growth Potential; else if total_active_users > 10 and customer_retention_30d > 0.7 → Stable Growth; otherwise Limited Growth. - Aggregate platform_wide_kpis across all accounts in revenue_health_indicators: - total_accounts = distinct account count; paying_accounts = distinct account count where agent_is_paying; conversion_rate = paying_accounts / total_accounts (no zero-denominator guard). - platform_total_users = sum(total_active_users); strategic_customers = sum(critical_customers + high_value_customers); customers_needing_attention = sum(customers_at_risk); new_customers_onboarding = sum(onboarding_customers). Sums ignore NULL inputs. - Averages (NULLs ignored): avg_platform_health_score, avg_platform_nps, avg_feature_adoption, avg_retention_rate, avg_customer_value. - Risk/growth counts: number of accounts labeled High/Medium/Low Risk; number with High Growth Potential; number with revenue_health_status = Excellent; number with revenue_health_status = Conversion Opportunity. - calculation_date = current_date at execution. - Compute trend_analysis from staging.stg_pendo__event over the last 30 days (occurred_at within 30 days of now): - For each day, compute: daily_active_accounts (distinct accounts), daily_active_users (distinct users), daily_total_events (sum of events), daily_total_minutes (sum of minutes). - Across these 30 days, compute averages of the daily metrics and user_activity_volatility as the standard deviation of daily_active_users. - user_growth_rate_7d = (average daily_active_users in the last 7 days minus average in the prior 7 days) divided by the prior 7-day average; if the denominator is zero or missing this rate is NULL; expose user_growth_rate_7d with NULL replaced by 0. - growth_trend_assessment is based on the unfilled (raw) user_growth_rate_7d: >0.1 Strong Growth; >0.05 Moderate Growth; >-0.05 Stable; >-0.1 Slight Decline; otherwise Concerning Decline (NULL falls to the final category). - Produce executive_summary_scorecard (final output, single row): - Cross join platform_wide_kpis with trend_analysis. - overall_business_health_score: weighted composite capped at 100 using: - 25% product health score; 15% normalized NPS (NPS shifted from [-1,1] to [0,100]); 15% feature adoption rate scaled to 0–100; 15% retention rate scaled to 0–100; 10% conversion rate scaled to 0–100; 20% growth component where baseline is 50 and adjusted upward by 100×growth when positive, or scaled down by multiplying 50 by (1 + growth) when negative; the growth rate used here is the coalesced value. - primary_alert_status (first match wins): high_risk_accounts > 20% of total_accounts → Account Risk Alert; avg_platform_nps < -0.2 → Customer Satisfaction Alert; user_growth_rate_7d < -0.1 → Growth Decline Alert; avg_retention_rate < 0.6 → Retention Alert; customers_needing_attention > 25% of platform_total_users → Customer Health Alert; otherwise All Systems Normal. - strategic_recommendation (first match wins): conversion_opportunities > 10% of paying_accounts → Focus on conversion optimization; high_growth_accounts > 20% of total_accounts → Capitalize on growth opportunities; customers_needing_attention > strategic_customers → Prioritize customer success initiatives; user_growth_rate_7d < 0 → Address user acquisition and retention; otherwise Maintain current strategy with incremental improvements. - generated_at = current_timestamp at execution.'
      columns:
      - name: total_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct account count across all accounts included in revenue_health_indicators
      - name: paying_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct account count where agent_is_paying is true
      - name: conversion_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: paying_accounts divided by total_accounts; no guard against zero denominator
      - name: platform_total_users
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Sum of total_active_users across accounts; NULL inputs are ignored
      - name: strategic_customers
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Sum of critical_customers plus high_value_customers across accounts
      - name: customers_needing_attention
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Sum of customers_at_risk across accounts
      - name: new_customers_onboarding
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Sum of onboarding_customers across accounts
      - name: avg_platform_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-account product_health_score; NULLs are ignored
      - name: avg_platform_nps
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-account account_nps; NULLs are ignored
      - name: avg_feature_adoption
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-account feature_adoption_rate; NULLs are ignored
      - name: avg_retention_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-account customer_retention_30d; NULLs are ignored
      - name: avg_customer_value
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of per-account avg_customer_value_score (default per account is 50.0)
      - name: high_risk_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of accounts labeled High Risk
      - name: medium_risk_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of accounts labeled Medium Risk
      - name: low_risk_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of accounts labeled Low Risk
      - name: high_growth_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of accounts labeled High Growth Potential
      - name: excellent_revenue_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of accounts with revenue health labeled Excellent
      - name: conversion_opportunities
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of accounts with revenue health labeled Conversion Opportunity
      - name: calculation_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: The current date at execution representing the snapshot date
      - name: user_growth_rate_7d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Change rate between last 7 days and the prior 7 days average of daily_active_users; coalesced to 0 when the rate is NULL
      - name: growth_trend_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Classification based on the raw (pre-coalesce) user_growth_rate_7d using fixed thresholds; NULL maps to Concerning Decline
      - name: avg_daily_active_users
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average daily_active_users over the last 30 days; NULL if no recent activity
      - name: user_activity_volatility
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Standard deviation of daily_active_users over the last 30 days; NULL if no recent activity
      - name: overall_business_health_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Weighted composite of platform KPIs and growth component capped at 100; NULL if any non-growth component is NULL
      - name: primary_alert_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary alert determined by ordered rules for risk share, NPS, growth decline, retention, and customer health
      - name: strategic_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Recommendation determined by ordered rules on conversion, growth opportunities, customer attention, and negative growth
      - name: generated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: The current timestamp at execution

references.name: staging.stg_pendo__account_history
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Build account_performance_summary: - Source: staging.stg_pendo__account_history left join intermediate.int_pendo__product_health_metrics on account_id. - One row per account with: account_id, account_name set equal to account_id, agent_is_paying=true, agent_planlevel=''Standard'', first_visit=first_visit_at, last_visit=last_visit_at. - Set per-account defaults: critical_customers=0, high_value_customers=0, customers_at_risk=0, onboarding_customers=0, total_active_users=0, avg_customer_value_score=50.0, high_ltv_customers=0. - For each account, derive product metrics as the maximum values across joined product_health rows: product_health_score (overall_health_score), account_nps (net_promoter_score), feature_adoption_rate, and customer_retention_30d. - Derive revenue_health_indicators from account_performance_summary: - revenue_health_status: - If agent_is_paying and avg_customer_value_score ≥ 80 → Excellent; if agent_is_paying and ≥ 60 → Good; if agent_is_paying and < 60 → At Risk. - If not paying and high_ltv_customers > 0 → Conversion Opportunity; otherwise Standard. - account_risk_level (in order): if customers_at_risk / total_active_users > 0.3 → High Risk; else if > 0.15 → Medium Risk; else if product_health_score < 50 → Medium Risk; else if account_nps < 0 → High Risk; otherwise Low Risk. When total_active_users=0, the ratio is treated as NULL and later rules apply. - growth_potential (in order): if high_ltv_customers > (critical_customers + high_value_customers) and feature_adoption_rate > 0.4 → High Growth Potential; else if onboarding_customers > 0 and avg_customer_value_score > 60 → Moderate Growth Potential; else if total_active_users > 10 and customer_retention_30d > 0.7 → Stable Growth; otherwise Limited Growth. - Aggregate platform_wide_kpis across all accounts in revenue_health_indicators: - total_accounts = distinct account count; paying_accounts = distinct account count where agent_is_paying; conversion_rate = paying_accounts / total_accounts (no zero-denominator guard). - platform_total_users = sum(total_active_users); strategic_customers = sum(critical_customers + high_value_customers); customers_needing_attention = sum(customers_at_risk); new_customers_onboarding = sum(onboarding_customers). Sums ignore NULL inputs. - Averages (NULLs ignored): avg_platform_health_score, avg_platform_nps, avg_feature_adoption, avg_retention_rate, avg_customer_value. - Risk/growth counts: number of accounts labeled High/Medium/Low Risk; number with High Growth Potential; number with revenue_health_status = Excellent; number with revenue_health_status = Conversion Opportunity. - calculation_date = current_date at execution. - Compute trend_analysis from staging.stg_pendo__event over the last 30 days (occurred_at within 30 days of now): - For each day, compute: daily_active_accounts (distinct accounts), daily_active_users (distinct users), daily_total_events (sum of events), daily_total_minutes (sum of minutes). - Across these 30 days, compute averages of the daily metrics and user_activity_volatility as the standard deviation of daily_active_users. - user_growth_rate_7d = (average daily_active_users in the last 7 days minus average in the prior 7 days) divided by the prior 7-day average; if the denominator is zero or missing this rate is NULL; expose user_growth_rate_7d with NULL replaced by 0. - growth_trend_assessment is based on the unfilled (raw) user_growth_rate_7d: >0.1 Strong Growth; >0.05 Moderate Growth; >-0.05 Stable; >-0.1 Slight Decline; otherwise Concerning Decline (NULL falls to the final category). - Produce executive_summary_scorecard (final output, single row): - Cross join platform_wide_kpis with trend_analysis. - overall_business_health_score: weighted composite capped at 100 using: - 25% product health score; 15% normalized NPS (NPS shifted from [-1,1] to [0,100]); 15% feature adoption rate scaled to 0–100; 15% retention rate scaled to 0–100; 10% conversion rate scaled to 0–100; 20% growth component where baseline is 50 and adjusted upward by 100×growth when positive, or scaled down by multiplying 50 by (1 + growth) when negative; the growth rate used here is the coalesced value. - primary_alert_status (first match wins): high_risk_accounts > 20% of total_accounts → Account Risk Alert; avg_platform_nps < -0.2 → Customer Satisfaction Alert; user_growth_rate_7d < -0.1 → Growth Decline Alert; avg_retention_rate < 0.6 → Retention Alert; customers_needing_attention > 25% of platform_total_users → Customer Health Alert; otherwise All Systems Normal. - strategic_recommendation (first match wins): conversion_opportunities > 10% of paying_accounts → Focus on conversion optimization; high_growth_accounts > 20% of total_accounts → Capitalize on growth opportunities; customers_needing_attention > strategic_customers → Prioritize customer success initiatives; user_growth_rate_7d < 0 → Address user acquisition and retention; otherwise Maintain current strategy with incremental improvements. - generated_at = current_timestamp at execution.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: feature
      description: Feature dimension enriched by aggregated usage metrics from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event joined to attributes from intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info
      grain: One row per feature_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      business_logic: '- Read all feature event rows. - For each feature_id, compute: - count_visitors: number of unique non-null visitor_id. - count_accounts: number of unique non-null account_id. - sum_clicks: total of num_events, ignoring NULL values. - count_click_events: number of event rows. - first_click_at: earliest occurred_at across rows, ignoring NULL values. - last_click_at: latest occurred_at across rows, ignoring NULL values. - avg_visitor_minutes: total num_minutes divided by the visitor count; if the visitor count is zero, the result is NULL. - avg_visitor_events: total num_events divided by the visitor count; if the visitor count is zero, the result is NULL. - Read feature attributes from intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info. - Left join metrics to features on feature_id; retain all features even when no events exist. - Final formatting: - count_visitors, count_accounts, sum_clicks, count_click_events: set to 0 when NULL. - avg_visitor_minutes, avg_visitor_events: rounded to 3 decimal places and set to 0 when NULL. - first_click_at and last_click_at: remain NULL when no events. - Output one row per feature_id combining all feature attributes and computed metrics.'
      columns:
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique feature identifier and join key; exactly one output row per feature_id
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Pendo application identifier from feature_info
      - name: created_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature creation timestamp from feature_info
      - name: created_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who created the feature from feature_info
      - name: is_dirty
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating unsaved changes from feature_info
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Group identifier from feature_info
      - name: is_core_event
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating core event feature from feature_info
      - name: last_updated_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Last update timestamp from feature_info
      - name: last_updated_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who last updated the feature from feature_info
      - name: feature_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature display name from feature_info
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated page identifier from feature_info
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier from feature_info
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier from feature_info
      - name: valid_through
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature validity end timestamp from feature_info
      - name: product_area_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product area name from feature_info
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated page name from feature_info
      - name: page_created_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page creation timestamp from feature_info
      - name: page_valid_through
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Page validity end timestamp from feature_info
      - name: app_display_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application display name from feature_info
      - name: app_platform
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application platform from feature_info
      - name: created_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the feature creator from feature_info
      - name: created_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Username of the feature creator from feature_info
      - name: last_updated_by_user_full_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Full name of the last updater from feature_info
      - name: last_updated_by_user_username
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Username of the last updater from feature_info
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique non-null visitor count per feature_id; set to 0 when no events
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique non-null account count per feature_id; set to 0 when no events
      - name: sum_clicks
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total num_events per feature_id with NULL values ignored; set to 0 when no events
      - name: count_click_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of event rows per feature_id; set to 0 when no events
      - name: first_click_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Earliest occurred_at per feature_id; NULL when no events
      - name: last_click_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest occurred_at per feature_id; NULL when no events
      - name: avg_visitor_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total minutes divided by unique non-null visitors per feature_id; rounded to 3 decimals; set to 0 when no visitors
      - name: avg_visitor_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total events divided by unique non-null visitors per feature_id; rounded to 3 decimals; set to 0 when no visitors

blocks.original_text:
- name: feature_daily_metrics
      description: Daily feature usage joined to a date spine and the active feature_info window; missing numeric metrics default to 0.
      grain: One row per feature_id per date_day per active feature_info record
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info
      - intermediate.int_pendo__feature_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- Build a daily date spine from intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine using date_day. - From intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info, derive created_on as the calendar date of created_at and valid_through_date as the calendar date of valid_through; if valid_through is blank, use the current date. Carry feature attributes (feature_id, feature_name, group_id/product_area ID, product_area_name, page_id, page_name). - Create feature_spine by keeping rows where date_day falls between created_on and valid_through_date, inclusive; this yields one row per calendar day per active feature_info record. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__feature_daily_metrics on date_day equals occurred_on and feature_id equals feature_id to bring daily metric values. - For all numeric metric columns from daily_metrics, replace NULL with 0; attribute columns are passed through from feature_info as available. - No aggregation, sorting, or de-duplication is performed; if multiple matching feature_info or daily_metrics rows exist for a given feature_id and date_day, multiple output rows will result.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date sourced from the spine; never NULL.
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature identifier from feature_info used to join daily metrics.
      - name: feature_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Feature name from the feature_info record active on date_day; may be NULL.
      - name: group_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Product area ID (group_id) from the feature_info record active on date_day; may be NULL.
      - name: product_area_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Product area name from the feature_info record active on date_day; may be NULL.
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated page identifier from the feature_info record active on date_day; may be NULL.
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Associated page name from the feature_info record active on date_day; may be NULL.
      - name: sum_clicks
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total clicks for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique visitors for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Unique accounts for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: count_first_time_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: First-time visitors for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: count_first_time_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: First-time accounts for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: count_return_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Returning visitors for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: count_return_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Returning accounts for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: avg_daily_minutes_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average minutes per visitor for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: avg_daily_clicks_per_visitor
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average clicks per visitor for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.
      - name: percent_of_daily_feature_clicks
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of the day’s feature clicks attributable to this feature from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0; scale unchanged.
      - name: percent_of_daily_feature_visitors
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of the day’s feature visitors attributable to this feature from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0; scale unchanged.
      - name: percent_of_daily_feature_accounts
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Share of the day’s feature accounts attributable to this feature from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0; scale unchanged.
      - name: count_click_events
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total click event records for the feature on date_day from daily_metrics; NULL becomes 0.

blocks.original_text:
- name: feature_event
      description: Feature interaction events enriched with current and previous feature metadata
      grain: One row per stg_pendo__feature_event record with a matching feature_id in int_pendo__feature_info
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_pendo__feature_event
      - intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor
      business_logic: '- Begin with all rows and columns from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event; no filtering, casting, or aggregation. - For each visitor_id, sort events by occurred_at ascending and populate: - previous_feature_id: the feature_id from the immediately prior event for that visitor. - previous_feature_event_at: the occurred_at from the immediately prior event. - previous_feature_num_minutes: the num_minutes from the immediately prior event. - previous_feature_num_events: the num_events from the immediately prior event. If there is no prior event, these fields are NULL. If multiple events share the same occurred_at for a visitor, the chosen prior row follows the database’s default ordering. - Inner join to intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info on the current event’s feature_id to add current feature attributes (feature_name, page_id, page_name, product_area_name, group_id as product_area_id, app_display_name, app_platform). Events without a match are removed. - Left join to intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info on previous_feature_id to add previous feature attributes (previous_feature_name, previous_feature_page_id, previous_feature_page_name, previous_feature_product_area_name, previous_feature_product_area_id). If previous_feature_id is NULL or has no match, these attributes are NULL. - Left join to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor on visitor_id and intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account on account_id; no columns are selected from these joins. Row count is unchanged unless duplicate keys exist in those sources. - Output all source columns, the four previous_* fields, and the selected current and previous feature attributes; no final ordering is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source account identifier; used only to support a left join; pass-through; may be NULL
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source application identifier; pass-through; may be NULL
      - name: feature_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current event feature identifier; required for the inner join to feature_info; events without a match are dropped
      - name: num_events
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Event count for this record; pass-through; may be NULL; no rounding applied
      - name: num_minutes
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Elapsed minutes for this record; pass-through; may be NULL; no rounding applied
      - name: remote_ip
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source remote IP address; pass-through; may be NULL; no normalization applied
      - name: server_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source server name; pass-through; may be NULL; no normalization applied
      - name: occurred_at
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Event timestamp used to order events within each visitor ascending; ties are not deterministically broken
      - name: user_agent
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source user agent string; pass-through; may be NULL; casing and whitespace preserved
      - name: visitor_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Visitor identifier that defines the window for previous_* calculations; pass-through; may be NULL
      - name: feature_event_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Opaque event key from the source; pass-through; uniqueness not enforced
      - name: previous_feature_id

references.line_text: business_logic: '- Begin with all rows and columns from staging.stg_pendo__feature_event; no filtering, casting, or aggregation. - For each visitor_id, sort events by occurred_at ascending and populate: - previous_feature_id: the feature_id from the immediately prior event for that visitor. - previous_feature_event_at: the occurred_at from the immediately prior event. - previous_feature_num_minutes: the num_minutes from the immediately prior event. - previous_feature_num_events: the num_events from the immediately prior event. If there is no prior event, these fields are NULL. If multiple events share the same occurred_at for a visitor, the chosen prior row follows the database’s default ordering. - Inner join to intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info on the current event’s feature_id to add current feature attributes (feature_name, page_id, page_name, product_area_name, group_id as product_area_id, app_display_name, app_platform). Events without a match are removed. - Left join to intermediate.int_pendo__feature_info on previous_feature_id to add previous feature attributes (previous_feature_name, previous_feature_page_id, previous_feature_page_name, previous_feature_product_area_name, previous_feature_product_area_id). If previous_feature_id is NULL or has no match, these attributes are NULL. - Left join to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_visitor on visitor_id and intermediate.int_pendo__latest_account on account_id; no columns are selected from these joins. Row count is unchanged unless duplicate keys exist in those sources. - Output all source columns, the four previous_* fields, and the selected current and previous feature attributes; no final ordering is applied.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: guide
      description: Guide attributes from intermediate.int_pendo__guide_info joined with selected all-time metrics from intermediate.int_pendo__guide_alltime_metrics.
      grain: One row per row in intermediate.int_pendo__guide_info; rows may multiply if multiple metrics rows exist for a guide_id.
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_info
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_alltime_metrics
      business_logic: '- Use all rows and columns from intermediate.int_pendo__guide_info as the base; no filtering, casting, aggregation, or deduplication is applied. - Left join intermediate.int_pendo__guide_alltime_metrics on guide_id. - Include only these fields from the metrics table: count_accounts, count_visitors_advanced, count_visitors_dismissed, count_visitors_shown, count_visitors, first_event_at, last_event_at. - Do not default or coalesce metrics; when there is no matching metrics row, these fields remain NULL. - If guide_info contains duplicate guide_id values, those duplicates are preserved. - If the metrics table has multiple rows for a guide_id, one output row is produced for each matching combination, increasing row counts. - No ordering is applied; output order is not guaranteed.'

      - name: guide_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide identifier from guide_info (join key; pass-through; NULL not allowed).

blocks.original_text:
- name: guide_daily_metrics
      description: Daily guide-by-day spine from guide creation through the build date with left-joined usage metrics.
      grain: One row per guide_id per date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__calendar_spine
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_info
      - intermediate.int_pendo__guide_daily_metrics
      business_logic: '- From guide info, derive created_on as the calendar day of created_at; keep guide_id and guide_name. - Build a guide-by-day spine by joining the calendar spine where date_day falls between created_on and the warehouse current date (inclusive at both ends). - For each (guide_id, date_day) in the spine, left join daily metrics where occurred_on equals date_day and guide_id matches. - Output date_day, guide_id, guide_name, count_accounts, and count_visitors exactly as in sources. - Missing metric rows are not backfilled; if no match exists, metric fields remain NULL. - No aggregation, de-duplication, or ordering is applied; duplicate source rows propagate as-is. - The upper bound (current date) is evaluated at model run time using the warehouse clock.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date in the spine from guide creation through the build date; join key to daily metrics by occurred_on.
      - name: guide_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide identifier from guide info; key for the spine and the metrics join.
      - name: guide_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Guide name from guide info at build time; not historically versioned.
      - name: count_accounts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily account count from the metrics table when date_day matches occurred_on and guide_id matches; NULL if no match; not aggregated.
      - name: count_visitors
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Daily visitor count from the metrics table when date_day matches occurred_on and guide_id matches; NULL if no match; not aggregated.

blocks.original_text:
- name: page
      description: Core page dimension with latest page attributes joined to aggregated event metrics
      grain: One row per page_id from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - staging.stg_pendo__page_event
      business_logic: '- Build event metrics from staging.stg_pendo__page_event grouped by page_id: - Distinct visitor count. - Distinct account count. - Total pageviews as the sum of num_events (null values do not contribute). - Total event records counted across all rows. - First and last pageview timestamps as the earliest and latest occurred_at. - Visitor averages: - Average minutes per distinct visitor = total num_minutes divided by the distinct visitor count. - Average pageviews per distinct visitor = total num_events divided by the distinct visitor count. - When the distinct visitor count is zero, these averages are not computed. - Left join these metrics to intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page on page_id. - Apply final handling: - Counts and sums default to 0 when there are no matching events. - Averages are rounded to 3 decimal places and default to 0 when no visitors. - First and last pageview timestamps remain null when there are no matching events. - Output includes all columns from latest_page plus the metrics; one row per page_id present in latest_page.'
      columns:
      - name: page_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique page identifier and join key; exactly one row per page_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: page_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Latest page name from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: app_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page

        data_type: TIMESTAMP

      - name: is_dirty

        description: Group identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page

        description: Last update timestamp from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: last_updated_by_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User ID who last updated the page from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: root_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Root version identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: stable_version_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Stable version identifier from intermediate.int_pendo__latest_page
      - name: valid_through
